overview: 今日共收录72篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: A data-driven approach for systematic correction of electronic bandgaps
full_list.title_zh: 电子带隙系统校正的数据驱动方法
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10889v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that a single machine-learning correction, applied to bandgaps from density functional theory calculations with two of the most frequently used energy functionals, results in bandgaps that are close to the experimental values. This solves a classical problem of computationally efficient electronic structure methods, to give reliable bandgaps that can be compared to experiments. The employed approach relies on materials specific feature engineering of machine learning models, and is shown to have close accuracy to that of much more expensive calculations based on the GW-approximation or hybrid functionals. The findings reported here open the possibility to use efficient calculations in materials design workflows that need reliable bandgaps, with implications for investigations targeting large computational databases or for investigations that are entirely predictive in nature.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们证明，将单个机器学习校正应用于使用两种最常用的能量泛函的密度泛函理论计算的带隙，会产生接近实验值的带隙。这解决了计算高效的电子结构方法的经典问题，给出了可以与实验进行比较的可靠带隙。所采用的方法依赖于机器学习模型的材料特定特征工程，并且被证明与基于 GW 近似或混合泛函的更昂贵的计算具有接近的准确性。这里报告的研究结果开启了在需要可靠带隙的材料设计工作流程中使用高效计算的可能性，这对针对大型计算数据库的研究或本质上完全预测的研究具有影响。

full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: MCSA: Multi-Cutoff Spectral Aggregation in SO(3) Equivariant GNNs for Interatomic Potentials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：MCSA: Multi-Cutoff Spectral Aggregation in SO(3) Equivariant GNNs for Interatomic Potentials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11226v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials (MLIPs) based on Equivariant Graph Neural Networks (EGNNs) have achieved remarkable progress in atomistic modeling. However, accurately representing atomic interactions across different spatial scales remains challenging. In this work, we investigate the radial spectral properties of SO(3)-equivariant message passing and establish that the cutoff radius controls the characteristic spatial-frequency scale of radial interactions. Based on this analysis, we propose Multi-Cutoff Spectral Aggregation (MCSA), a plug-and-play module that aggregates radial kernels with different cutoff radii to enrich multi-scale geometric representations. To achieve efficient implementation, we exploit the compact support of radial kernels to fuse cutoff-dependent radial weights before angular tensor-product operations, avoiding redundant angular computations while preserving rotational equivariance. Extensive experiments across representative EGNN backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in energy, force, and stress prediction, as well as enhanced accuracy in higher-order properties, including phonon dispersion and lattice thermal conductivity. Further evaluations on layered materials with distinct interaction scales demonstrate the effectiveness of physically motivated cutoff selection. Code is available at: https://github.com/JF-Tan/MCSA.

full_list.title_en: Defects and Structural Evolution in CrSBr: Machine-Learning Potentials for Atomistic Simulations
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Defects and Structural Evolution in CrSBr: Machine-Learning Potentials for Atomistic Simulations
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The layered van der Waals semiconductor CrSBr combines intrinsic magnetic order with semiconducting and optical properties, making it a promising material for multifunctional electronic and photonic applications. Understanding how defects and structural transformations affect its properties under experimentally relevant conditions, however, remains challenging for first-principles simulations due to the relevant length and time scales. Here, we develop and benchmark machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for the Cr-S-Br system, enabling large-scale atomistic simulations of CrSBr with accuracy approaching that of density functional theory (DFT). The charge-aware variant qNEP achieves near-DFT accuracy in predicting lattice constants, formation enthalpies, vacancy energetics, and the anisotropic pressure response of o-CrSBr. Nudged elastic band calculations reveal that pre-existing S vacancies lower the Cr Frenkel-pair migration barrier by up to 1.1 eV, providing an atomistic mechanism for beam-induced Cr redistribution and structural transformations. Displacement threshold calculations further show that Br is the most susceptible species to electron-beam-induced displacement, identifying the relative ease of removing different atomic species. Together, these results establish a validated computational framework for investigating atomic-scale disorder and structural transformations in CrSBr, providing a basis for defect engineering in materials for future magneto-optoelectronic applications.

full_list.title_en: AI-Driven Discovery of Entanglement Witness in Spin Hamiltonians
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：AI-Driven Discovery of Entanglement Witness in Spin Hamiltonians
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11935v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Entanglement is a crucial resource in quantum science and engineering, but detecting it in many-body states from experimentally accessible observables remains challenging. Here we introduce EntNet, an AI-driven framework to discover compact combinations of spin observables that accurately distinguish entangled from fully separable many-body mixed states in one-dimensional spin-1/2 chains governed by short-range Hamiltonians. We construct local-unitary-invariant representations of measurable Pauli correlators up to four-body order, sparsely select 16 candidate invariant feature channels, and learn their spatial structure using a Transformer architecture with rotary positional embeddings. Using only expectation values of these low-order observables, EntNet achieves >98% recall on certified entangled states with near-zero false-positive rates on separable states. Remarkably, it exhibits transferability across system sizes and distinct Hamiltonian families, including frustrated and disordered spin models, with minimal loss of accuracy. Beyond detection, EntNet provides physical insight into entanglement detection by revealing a selective spatial organization of pair correlations, while its finite-temperature decision boundary tracks the excitation gap of Jordan-Wigner quasiparticles. These results establish a transferable and physically interpretable framework for data-driven discovery of entanglement witnesses from local correlation functions.

full_list.title_en: Experimentally Grounded Machine Learning of PrecursorSurface-Reactant Chemistry in Atomic Layer Deposition
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Experimentally Grounded Machine Learning of PrecursorSurface-Reactant Chemistry in Atomic Layer Deposition
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10024v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Whether a precursor-substrate-reactant combination yields an atomic layer deposition (ALD) process is still settled by trial-and-error experiments. Here we introduce AJIN (ALD Joint Interpretable Network), a machine-learning framework that learns this decision from experimental outcomes. We compiled 560 experimentally observed ALD and area-selective ALD outcomes spanning 76 precursors, 27 substrates, 20 reactants and 25-620 degrees Celsius. Following the ALD cycle, AJIN predicts adsorption from graph-neural-network embeddings of the precursor and substrate with temperature, and deposition by adding the reactant. The best model (CHGNet-MLP) reaches balanced accuracies of 79.2% for adsorption and 84.8% for deposition and transfers partially to unseen precursors. SHAP and ablation analyses show that substrate chemistry governs adsorption, whereas precursor, substrate and reactant all contribute to deposition. Tested against our laboratory's ALD experiments, AJIN correctly predicted 83% of new-substrate cases and 71% of new precursor-substrate adsorption cases, providing an experimentally grounded tool for prioritizing ALD and area-selective ALD chemistries.

full_list.title_en: Interpretable machine learning of formation energies and band gaps in hybrid perovskites through SHAP analysis and SISSO modelling
full_list.title_zh: 通过 SHAP 分析和 SISSO 建模对混合钙钛矿中的形成能和带隙进行可解释的机器学习
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate and interpretable property prediction is essential for exploring hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites. Here, we combine machine-learning screening with SHAP analysis and SISSO descriptor discovery. Using 4,456 compounds, optimized XGBoost models achieved test-set R² values of 0.99 for formation energy and 0.93 for band gap and were applied to over 180,000 candidates. Comparison across approximately 17,000 common compounds revealed broadly overlapping distributions from XGBoost and CGCNN but substantially lower predictions from UPET, suggesting potential limitations in its transferability to hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites. SHAP analysis and correlation-based pruning retained eight primary features for each property, from which SISSO derived expressions comprising four nonlinear descriptors. These expressions couple molecular and inorganic properties for formation energy and emphasize relative atomic sizes and B-site characteristics for band gap. This framework supports efficient candidate prioritization and interpretable analysis of learned structures-property relationships in hybrid perovskites.
full_list.abstract_zh: 准确且可解释的性质预测对于探索有机-无机杂化钙钛矿至关重要。在这里，我们将机器学习筛选与 SHAP 分析和 SISSO 描述符发现相结合。使用 4,456 种化合物，优化的 XGBoost 模型在测试集上实现了形成能 R² 值为 0.99，带隙 R² 值为 0.93，并应用于超过 180,000 个候选化合物。

full_list.title_en: PBE-assisted machine learning of HSE06+SOC photovoltaic efficiency in halide perovskites
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：PBE-assisted machine learning of HSE06+SOC photovoltaic efficiency in halide perovskites
full_list.abstract: Hybrid-functional calculations with spin–orbit coupling (HSE06 + SOC) provide more accurate electronic properties of halide perovskites than semilocal PBE calculations but are substantially more expensive. Here, we assess whether low-cost PBE information improves machine-learning (ML) prediction of HSE06 + SOC band gaps and spectroscopic limited maximum efficiency (SLME). Using a public dataset of 243 pure and mixed ABX₃ perovskites, we compare seven ML model families using nested cross-validation with random, chemical-system-grouped, and B-site-grouped splits. PBE inputs substantially improve SLME prediction: the mean absolute error decreases from 0.68 to 0.45 percentage points on chemical-system-grouped splits, with the best model achieving 0.36 percentage points. Δ-learning provides no advantage over direct learning. However, performance deteriorates when the B-site chemistry is absent from training, and conformal intervals become under-calibrated. An audit of the source labels further shows that the HSE06 + SOC SLME is strongly constrained by the HSE06 + SOC band gap and approaches a saturation near 16%, because the reported spectrum was generated by shifting the PBE absorption spectrum. These findings highlight both the value and limitations of PBE-assisted ML for multi-fidelity prediction of perovskite properties.

full_list.title_en: Machine Learning-Assisted Prediction of Brilliant Green Removal from Water Using CaTiO 3 Photocatalysis: Bayesian Optimization, SHAP Explainability, and Robustness Assessment
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Machine Learning-Assisted Prediction of Brilliant Green Removal from Water Using CaTiO 3 Photocatalysis: Bayesian Optimization, SHAP Explainability, and Robustness Assessment
full_list.abstract: Brilliant Green (BG)-contaminated wastewater threatens aquatic ecosystems by limiting light penetration, disrupting photosynthesis, and exposing organisms to potentially toxic compounds, raising broader environmental and human-health concerns. This study presents an explainable machine-learning framework for predicting BG removal during CaTiO3-assisted photocatalytic water treatment. Using 63 published experimental observations for the 2:7 precursor composition, six regression models Decision Tree, Random Forest, Extra Trees, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, and CatBoost were evaluated through Bayesian hyperparameter optimization and repeated cross-validation. Although Extra Trees achieved marginally higher holdout accuracy, CatBoost was selected for its superior repeated-validation performance, achieving a test R2 of 0.9884, RMSE of 3.4629 percentage points, and mean cross-validation R2 of 0.9697. SHAP analysis identified degradation time (60.57%), initial BG concentration (32.12%), and catalyst dosage (7.31%) as the principal contributors to model predictions. Feature-combination analysis reinforced this hierarchy, while CatBoost retained a test R2 of 0.9778 under 10% Gaussian noise. Predicted BG removal (89.32%) closely matched the reported experimental value (88.46%). These findings provide a promising foundation for future experimental validation, broader catalyst screening, and interpretable optimization of photocatalytic wastewater treatment.

full_list.title_en: FT-NIR Spectroscopy and Explainable Machine Learning for Eggshell Based Classification of Organic and Conventional Market Eggs
full_list.title_zh: FT-NIR 光谱和可解释的机器学习用于基于蛋壳的有机和传统市场鸡蛋分类
full_list.abstract: The premium pricing of organic eggs creates incentives for product misrepresentation and motivates the development of rapid, non-destructive screening tools to differentiate labeled organic and conventional eggs. Fourier transform near-infrared (FT-NIR) spectroscopy coupled with machine learning was evaluated for classifying retail eggs marketed as organic versus conventional. A total of 147 eggs were measured and spectra were analyzed using partial least squares–discriminant analysis (PLS-DA), along with gradient-boosted tree models (XGBoost and LightGBM). The dataset was partitioned into training (70%) and testing (30%) sets. Among the evaluated models, PLS-DA achieved the best test performance with an overall accuracy of 91.0%. To improve interpretability, SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) were used to identify wavelengths that most strongly contributed to model predictions. Influential regions included bands near ~1400 nm, consistent with O-H absorptions commonly associated with moisture-related spectral features, and regions near ~2300 nm, which are often associated with crystalline calcium-carbonate-related absorptions in the near-infrared and may reflect variation in mineral-associated spectral response of eggshell. These results indicate that FT-NIR spectroscopy combined with machine learning can differentiate retail eggs labeled as organic versus conventional under the conditions of this study, supporting further development of rapid screening approaches for market classification and quality assurance applications.

full_list.title_en: Out-of-the-Box Tabular Foundation Models for Bayesian Optimization in Materials Discovery
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Out-of-the-Box Tabular Foundation Models for Bayesian Optimization in Materials Discovery
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12491v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Bayesian optimization is widely used in active learning loops for materials science. Gaussian processes serve as the de-facto surrogate model family, but require task-dependent kernel choices and can lack the modeling capacity for complex relationships. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have recently emerged as the state-of-the-art for predictive tasks on structured data, without requiring bespoke kernels or hyperparameter tuning. We evaluate two TFMs, TabPFN and TabICL, as out-of-the-box surrogate models on two standard materials science benchmarks, comparing against a large field of baselines encompassing Gaussian processes, random forests, and CatBoost. Our findings indicate that TFMs are highly competitive surrogate models across the two benchmarks, without task-specific training for active learning or GP kernel selection. Our results motivate developing TFMs further as surrogates for active learning in materials discovery.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12573v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Exploratory ab initio molecular dynamics is used to construct machine-learning interatomic potentials for NO interactions with highly oriented pyrolytic graphite at 33% bridge-site oxygen coverage. Representative configurations sampled across surface temperatures and incidence energies provide reference energies and forces for training and validation. The selected potential enables relaxation of 300 adsorption configurations and construction of spatial and angular interaction maps. These maps reveal increasingly restricted attractive regions during vertical approach and reduced short-range repulsion upon molecular reorientation. The resulting adsorption geometries and interaction landscapes guide further first-principles sampling toward refining potentials for NO oxidation dynamics.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10046v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper describes the 2026 edition of the Topological Deep Learning Challenge: Bridging the Gap, hosted at the second Topology, Algebra, and Geometry in Data Science (TAG-DS) Conference. Where previous editions grew the modelling and data ecosystem of Topological Deep Learning (TDL), this edition set out to place Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Topological Neural Networks (TNNs) side by side under a single evaluation pipeline. Participants implemented recent state-of-the-art architectures in TopoBench, with Track 1 covering GNNs and Track 2 covering TNNs. They evaluated these implementations on shared synthetic benchmarks generated with GraphUniverse, which independently controls homophily, average degree and degree-distribution heaviness. The challenge yielded 68 qualifying submissions from 34 teams, spanning the graph, simplicial, cellular, hypergraph and combinatorial domains. For the first time, submissions were also tracked on a public leaderboard, which we summarize and analyze here. Our analysis finds that the differences between the submitted tracks are strongly task-dependent: the mean accuracy gap is modest on community detection, while on triangle counting the Track 1 mean error is 1.85 times the Track 2 mean. Several structurally informed GNNs also outperform the Track 2 mean on triangle counting.

full_list.title_en: A Differentiable DFT-Based Framework for Inverse Materials Design
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Differentiable DFT-Based Framework for Inverse Materials Design
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.25502v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Discovering solid-state materials with target properties remains a central challenge in computational materials science. Existing data-driven approaches rely on training data and may generalize poorly outside the training distribution. Here we develop a first-principles inverse-design framework that requires no training data. It integrates reverse-mode automatic differentiation (AD) into the Korringa--Kohn--Rostoker method combined with the coherent potential approximation (KKR-CPA), in which elemental concentrations serve as continuous optimization variables. Reverse-mode AD computes all concentration gradients in one backward pass, enabling optimization over dozens of candidate elements. Any differentiable quantity computable within KKR-CPA can serve as an optimization objective. We demonstrate this generality in permanent-magnet and half-metal design, identifying candidates such as (Nd₀.₉₈₃Pr₀.₀₁₇)(Co₀.₇₂Fe₀.₂₈)₂Fe₃ and FeMn(As₀.₈₃P₀.₁₇), respectively. We also synthesized materials with five SmCo₅-based compositions selected during optimization for higher magnetization. Their measured magnetization agreed closely with calculated values. Our framework offers a first-principles route to designing materials with target properties.

full_list.title_en: Strain-dependent Dynamics of Interactions of Iodine-vacancy pairs in CsPbI3: A DFT and Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics Study
full_list.title_zh: CsPbI3 中碘空位对相互作用的应变相关动力学：DFT 和机器学习分子动力学研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Iodine-vacancy migration and association are important factors in the structural stability of halide perovskites. Although neighboring vacancies have been suggested to form energetically favorable pairs, their stability and reconfiguration under finite-temperature lattice deformation remain unclear. Here, we combine machine-learning molecular dynamics (MLMD) and density functional theory (DFT) to investigate neighboring iodine vacancies in tilted CsPbI3 under isotropic and biaxial strain. The MLMD trajectories reveal a nonmonotonic dependence of short-time hopping fractions on strain, with strong isotropic compression favoring point-like separation and tension promoting pair-preserving relay hopping. Notably, biaxial compression produces distinct orientation-dependent responses: vacancy pairs initially aligned with the compressed plane preferentially undergo separation, whereas those perpendicular to the plane predominantly exhibit relay hopping. Complementary static calculations using DFT and the SevenNet-0 potential yield repulsive interactions for all configurations examined. These findings highlight the importance of finite-temperature dynamics and strain-dependent local geometry in understanding vacancy-pair stability and reconfiguration in halide perovskites.
full_list.abstract_zh: 碘空位迁移和缔合是卤化物钙钛矿结构稳定性的重要因素。尽管相邻的空位被认为可以形成能量上有利的对，但它们在有限温度晶格变形下的稳定性和重构仍不清楚。在这里，我们结合机器学习分子动力学 (MLMD) 和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 来研究各向同性和双轴应变下倾斜 CsPbI3 中的邻近碘空位。 MLMD 轨迹揭示了短时跳跃分数对应变的非单调依赖性，强各向同性压缩有利于点状分离，而张力促进了成对保留中继跳跃。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 碘空位迁移和缔合是卤化物钙钛矿结构稳定性的重要因素。尽管相邻的空位被认为可以形成能量上有利的对，但它们在有限温度晶格变形下的稳定性和重构仍不清楚。在这里，我们结合机器学习分子动力学 (MLMD) 和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 来研究各向同性和双轴应变下倾斜 CsPbI3 中的邻近碘空位。 MLMD 轨迹揭示了短时跳跃分数对应变的非单调依赖性，强各向同性压缩有利于点状分离，而张力促进了成对保留中继跳跃。值得注意的是，双轴压缩产生明显的方向相关响应：最初与压缩平面对齐的空位对优先经历分离，而垂直于平面的空位对主要表现出中继跳跃。使用 DFT 和 SevenNet-0 进行互补静态计算，对所有检查的配置产生排斥相互作用。这些发现强调了有限温度动力学和应变相关的局部几何形状在理解卤化物钙钛矿中的空位对稳定性和重构方面的重要性。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹, 密度泛函理论和电子结构计算，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《CsPbI3 中碘空位对相互作用的应变相关动力学：DFT 和机器学习分子动力学研究》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Engineering ferroelectric nanocapacitors through interfacial phonon bias
full_list.title_zh: 通过界面声子偏置设计铁电纳米电容器
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11256v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As ferroelectric devices approach the nanometer scale, their behavior becomes increasingly sensitive to boundary conditions. In perovskite oxide nanocapacitors, epitaxial strain and electrostatic screening are well-established control parameters. Then, while expected to contribute to the epitaxial stabilization of ferroelectric ultrathin films, the lattice-dynamical state of the electrodes has not been isolated as an independent tuning knob. Here we call this poorly explored coupling interfacial phonon bias, whereby the electrodes' phonon energy landscape reshapes that of the adjacent ferroelectric across their shared interface. Using first-principles-accurate machine-learned interatomic potentials and molecular-dynamics simulations, we examine this mechanism in symmetric BiFeO{}₃ nanocapacitors in contact with a metallic perovskite oxide. By independently controlling the orientatio and amplitude of the electrodes' octahedral-tilt landscape, while keeping conventional elastic and electric boundary conditions fixed, we show that the electrodes' phonon energy landscape can modify the stability of competing BiFeO{}₃ phases. In particular, this allows us to shift the ferroelectric transition temperature and even induce antiferroelectric-like switching at ambient conditions. We thus showcase interfacial phonon bias as a complementary and powerful strategy to modify and optimize the properties of ultrathin epitaxial films.
full_list.abstract_zh: 随着铁电器件接近纳米尺度，它们的行为对边界条件变得越来越敏感。在钙钛矿氧化物纳米电容器中，外延应变和静电屏蔽是公认的控制参数。然后，虽然预计有助于铁电超薄膜的外延稳定，但电极的晶格动力学状态尚未被隔离为独立的调谐旋钮。在这里，我们将这种探索不足的耦合界面声子偏置称为耦合界面声子偏置，电极的声子能量景观通过其共享界面重塑相邻铁电体的声子能量景观。利用第一原理精确的机器学习原子间势和分子动力学模拟，我们研究了与金属钙钛矿氧化物接触的对称 BiFeO{}₃ 纳米电容器中的这种机制。

full_list.title_en: Overcoming speed-accuracy trade-offs with medium-sized interatomic potentials
full_list.title_zh: 克服中等原子间势的速度与精度的权衡
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current machine-learned interatomic potentials offer a choice between small, fast models and large, expressive networks. This study demonstrates how an intermediate potential can approach the limit of transferable accuracy at the cost of the cheapest existing formalisms. Specifically, we model He-bearing W-Ta-Hf-Cr-V-Ti alloys with an atomic cluster expansion that learns the radial components of each polynomial as independent linear transforms and embeds numerous densities with learned exponents. While (near-)training loss appears largely a function of model size, the error on a distinct validation set is close to that of leading potentials with ten times more parameters. Taking advantage of the new structure, we develop optimized implementations that run more than an order of magnitude faster than the larger models and many times faster than smaller models with equivalent polynomials. The potential is trained on systematically enumerated small structures but generalizes to point and planar defects and can be extended to even more complex chemistries. As a demonstration, we simulate radiation-damage cascades in billion-atom systems for hundreds of thousands of timesteps.
full_list.abstract_zh: 当前的机器学习原子间势提供了小型、快速模型和大型、富有表现力的网络之间的选择。这项研究展示了中间势如何以最便宜的现有形式主义为代价接近可转移精度的极限。具体来说，我们使用原子团簇展开对含氦 W-Ta-Hf-Cr-V-Ti 合金进行建模，该原子团簇展开将每个多项式的径向分量学习为独立的线性变换，并使用学习的指数嵌入大量密度。虽然（接近）训练损失很大程度上取决于模型大小，但不同验证集上的误差接近于参数多十倍的领先潜力的误差。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 当前的机器学习原子间势提供了小型、快速模型和大型、富有表现力的网络之间的选择。这项研究展示了中间势如何以最便宜的现有形式主义为代价接近可转移精度的极限。具体来说，我们使用原子团簇展开对含氦 W-Ta-Hf-Cr-V-Ti 合金进行建模，该原子团簇展开将每个多项式的径向分量学习为独立的线性变换，并使用学习的指数嵌入大量密度。虽然（接近）训练损失很大程度上取决于模型大小，但不同验证集上的误差接近于参数多十倍的领先潜力的误差。利用新结构，我们开发了优化的实现，其运行速度比较大模型快一个数量级以上，比具有等效多项式的较小模型快许多倍。这种潜力是针对系统枚举的小型结构进行训练的，但可以推广到点和平面缺陷，并且可以扩展到更复杂的化学物质。作为演示，我们模拟了十亿个原子系统中数十万个时间步长的辐射损伤级联。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《克服中等原子间势的速度与精度的权衡》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Learning Electronic Band Structures Across the s, p, d Blocks with an Empirical Pseudopotential Network
full_list.title_zh: 使用经验赝势网络学习跨 s、p、d 块的电子能带结构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic band structures govern how crystals conduct electrons and absorb light. Density-functional theory (DFT) computes them through costly self-consistent iterations, while existing machine-learning models either predict isolated scalar properties or output Hamiltonians that still require DFT solvers. Here we present EpNet, a learned empirical pseudopotential for crystals spanning 63 elements across the s, p and d blocks. An equivariant neural network builds its Hamiltonian from physics-motivated local potentials and nonlocal projectors. Trained solely on band energies, EpNet predicts complete band structures directly from atomic coordinates. On unseen chemical systems, its median errors are winAll eV for band energies and gapAll eV for band gaps. On 600,000 structures from an independent database, its band-gap errors are overall less than half those of existing models, at about 1% of DFT cost. EpNet thus enables fast screening of electronic properties for materials discovery and electronic-structure simulations of large systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电子能带结构控制晶体传导电子和吸收光的方式。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 通过成本高昂的自洽迭代来计算它们，而现有的机器学习模型要么预测孤立的标量属性，要么输出仍需要 DFT 求解器的哈密顿量。在这里，我们提出了 EpNet，这是一种学习的晶体经验赝势，跨越 s、p 和 d 块的 63 个元素。等变神经网络根据物理驱动的局部势和非局部投影构建其哈密顿量。 EpNet 仅根据能带能量进行训练，直接从原子坐标预测完整的能带结构。

full_list.title_en: An Extensible Agentic Framework for Expert-Level Automation of Atomistic Simulations
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：An Extensible Agentic Framework for Expert-Level Automation of Atomistic Simulations
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.09422v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Traditionally, atomistic simulation has been constrained by the computational scaling limits of ab initio methods and the parameterization overhead of empirical force fields. The recent emergence of universal machine learning interatomic potentials has significantly mitigated these bottlenecks, offering near-quantum accuracy and generalizability across diverse chemical spaces at a fraction of the computational cost. However, this shift has relocated the bottleneck to the human dimension: time-consuming mechanical processes, such as input preparation and data analysis, now dominate the research lifecycle. We introduce Paimon, a Platform for Agentic Integration in Materials Optimization and Nanoscale-simulations. Through hundreds of trials on an expert-level liquid electrolyte simulation, we show that Paimon substantially improves the reliability of agentic workflows by suppressing silent errors: plausible yet physically incorrect results. Paimon accommodates a new capability without modifying the agents already present, which we demonstrate by integrating an externally developed scientific agent. As an agent harness for atomistic simulations, Paimon affords researchers a continuous, science-centric workflow throughout the entire simulation lifecycle.

full_list.title_en: SATE: Transferable Spin-Adapted Neural Wavefunctions
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：SATE: Transferable Spin-Adapted Neural Wavefunctions
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate prediction of molecular reactivity requires both accurate and computationally efficient description of electron correlation and spin across various molecular geometries and electronic states. We introduce SATE, a spin-adapted transferable neural wavefunction architecture with effective core potentials. SATE combines a transferable neural wavefunction, the spin-adapted antisymmetrization method, and effective core potentials into a single foundation model architecture pretrained on compositions containing selected elements from hydrogen to bromine. After pretraining and adaptation, our model is able to predict 3d transition-metal spin-state gaps, bond dissociation energies, and reaction energies by addressing two key issues. First, including the core potentials into the model allows us to reduce the number of explicitly treated electrons. Second, using spin-adapted antisymmetrization enforces the prescribed total spin by construction. By testing our model with 3d transition metal chemistry, we evaluate our model's description of strong electron correlation and competing electronic states in such compounds. We find that pretraining improves most tested component energies at matched adaptation budgets, while improvements in spin-state gaps, dissociation energies, and reaction energies remain system dependent. Ultimately, our work lays the foundation for more accurate and transferable modeling of molecular systems by combining the computational efficiency of effective core potentials with explicit control over total spin.

full_list.title_en: A Reconfigurable Ferroelectric Acoustic Computational Primitive for Analog In-Memory Computing
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Reconfigurable Ferroelectric Acoustic Computational Primitive for Analog In-Memory Computing
full_list.abstract: The growing computational demands of artificial intelligence (AI) have renewed interest in emerging nonvolatile memory (eNVM) crossbar array technologies for in-memory computing to reduce the energy cost of moving data between processors and memory. Here we report a computational primitive that merges ferroelectric memory and acoustic resonators in a single platform: Ferroelectric memory Embedded in Nanoscale Acoustic resonators (FENA). We experimentally demonstrate over 100 nonvolatile analog admittance states arising from partial ferroelectric polarization switching in lithium niobate resonators. The devices exhibit highly symmetric potentiation and depression characteristics, which directly impact computation accuracy, favorable dynamic range and linearity, and low projected read and write energies after scaling. We further propose a radio frequency (RF) peripheral readout architecture that extracts frequency- and phase-sensitive effective conductance states to offer an expanded state space and hardware-level reconfigurability. System-level evaluation using the NeuroSim multi-layer perceptron (MLP) simulator demonstrates the suitability of FENA for both online and offline neural-network training, with scaled devices achieving competitive 84% and 92% classification accuracies, respectively.

full_list.title_en: A Geometry-Guided Feature-Space Framework for Interpretable Unsupervised 4D-STEM Analysis of Complex Multiphase Materials
full_list.title_zh: 用于复杂多相材料的可解释无监督 4D-STEM 分析的几何引导特征空间框架
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10853v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rapid, high-fidelity analysis of four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) datasets from heterogeneous materials remains challenging because coexisting phases, orientation variants, local strain gradients, and intrinsic TEM thin-foil effects produce complex, overlapping diffraction signatures. Here, we present a machine-learning (ML) framework that combines physics-informed geometric descriptors with weighted high-dimensional embeddings to identify latent structural patterns with minimal prior knowledge. By constructing a regularized descriptor space before embedding and density-based clustering, the method improves cluster stability, suppresses noise-driven fragmentation, and reduces sensitivity to embedding hyperparameters. Spatial weighting produced the largest stability gain, increasing median cluster persistence from 0.04 to 0.55 while reducing the noise fraction from approximately 22% to 0%. Rotation weighting increased DBCV from 0.80 to 0.92, although the noise fraction rose from 0.2% to 1.0%, highlighting a trade-off between improved density separation and noise rejection. We validate the framework on two benchmark systems: Si/SiₓGe₁₋ₓ epitaxial layers with continuous lattice variation and deformation, and multiphase Ti-Nb alloys containing distinct phases and orientation variants. Comparisons with a pretrained vanilla autoencoder and model-free pattern vectorization show that the physics-informed geometric descriptor provides higher cluster fidelity, greater interpretability, and substantially lower dimensionality.
full_list.abstract_zh: 对异质材料的四维扫描透射电子显微镜 (4D-STEM) 数据集进行快速、高保真分析仍然具有挑战性，因为共存相、方向变化、局部应变梯度和固有的 TEM 薄箔效应会产生复杂、重叠的衍射特征。在这里，我们提出了一个机器学习（ML）框架，它将物理信息的几何描述符与加权高维嵌入相结合，以最少的先验知识识别潜在的结构模式。通过在嵌入和基于密度的聚类之前构建正则化描述符空间，该方法提高了聚类稳定性，抑制了噪声驱动的碎片，并降低了对嵌入超参数的敏感性。

full_list.title_en: How Path Integral Diffusion Decides a Finite Spin Glass
full_list.title_zh: 路径积分扩散如何决定有限旋转玻璃
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11826v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When an AI diffusion-type generator samples a frustrated spin glass, which macroscopic alternatives does it decide first, and when? We study this for bridge-diffusion models of the Path Integral Diffusion (PID) type started from a point source. We show that every isotropic PID is a time-changed Gaussian stochastic localization, and conversely every signal-to-noise schedule is realized by a PID protocol. What a continuous-time generator decides therefore does not depend on the protocol, which only sets when and at what cost. We describe the generator's state by its partial commitments: the probabilities it assigns, at each moment, to nested classes of configurations fixed by the target. The partial commitments are martingales that move only along class contrasts. Their ensemble average gives the information about each level at an exact rate set by squared magnetization contrasts. Each split is decided, approximately, like a binary Gaussian channel at signal-to-noise ratio 1.04/λ_P, with λ_P the leading eigenvalue of the parent's correlation matrix. The theory is applied to Bethe-lattice and Sherrington--Kirkpatrick (SK) glasses with up to 64 spins. It is observed generically that a trajectory first shifts its weight to one of the two mirror halves of the zero-field measure and then to the glassy classes inside it. These classes appear near the glass transition and keep their identity on cooling. Nested glassy levels have similar λ_P and are decided together, so a trajectory commits in one or two distinct events---the mirror choice and a compound glassy decision---which separate further with coupling and size, as the spectra predict. For a generator that takes finitely many steps, the protocol matters through the late, local stage rather than the macroscopic decisions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 当人工智能扩散型发生器对沮丧的自旋玻璃进行采样时，它首先决定哪些宏观替代方案，以及何时决定？我们研究了从点源开始的路径积分扩散（ PID ）类型的桥扩散模型。我们证明了每个各向同性PID都是一个随时间变化的高斯随机定位，相反，每个信噪比调度都是通过PID协议实现的。因此，连续时间生成器决定的内容不取决于协议，协议仅设置何时以及以何种成本进行设置。我们通过其部分承诺来描述生成器的状态：它在每个时刻分配给目标固定的嵌套类配置的概率。部分承诺是只沿着阶级对比移动的貂。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 当人工智能扩散型发生器对沮丧的自旋玻璃进行采样时，它首先决定哪些宏观替代方案，以及何时决定？我们研究了从点源开始的路径积分扩散（ PID ）类型的桥扩散模型。我们证明了每个各向同性PID都是一个随时间变化的高斯随机定位，相反，每个信噪比调度都是通过PID协议实现的。因此，连续时间生成器决定的内容不取决于协议，协议仅设置何时以及以何种成本进行设置。我们通过其部分承诺来描述生成器的状态：它在每个时刻分配给目标固定的嵌套类配置的概率。部分承诺是只沿着阶级对比移动的貂。他们的集合平均值以平方磁化对比度设定的精确速率提供有关每个级别的信息。每个分割大致像信噪比为1.04/λ_P的二进制高斯信道一样被决定，其中λ_P是父相关矩阵的前导特征值。该理论应用于Bethe-lattice和Sherrington-Kirkpatrick （ SK ）眼镜，最多可旋转64圈。一般观察到，轨迹首先将其权重转移到零场测量的两个镜像半之一，然后转移到其内部的玻璃类。这些类出现在玻璃转换附近，并保持其冷却特性。嵌套的玻璃质水平具有相似的λ_P ，并且是共同决定的，因此轨迹在一个或两个不同的事件中提交-镜像选择和复合玻璃质决策-正如光谱预测的那样，它们通过耦合和大小进一步分离。对于需要有限步骤的生成器，协议在后期、局部阶段而不是宏观决策中起重要作用。

full_list.title_en: UniHam: A Large-Scale SOC-Complete Dataset and Benchmark for Hamiltonian Learning in Materials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：UniHam: A Large-Scale SOC-Complete Dataset and Benchmark for Hamiltonian Learning in Materials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12509v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate prediction of electronic Hamiltonians would enable broad property inference while avoiding the high computational cost of Density Functional Theory (DFT). However, progress toward general-purpose materials foundation models is limited by a data bottleneck: existing Hamiltonian datasets are typically small, lack structural diversity, and often omit essential relativistic physics such as spin--orbit coupling (SOC). We therefore construct UniHam, a large-scale Hamiltonian dataset and benchmark suite comprising 100,000+ DFT-computed complex-valued Hermitian Hamiltonians with full SOC, covering 72 elements and a wide range of crystal geometries and symmetries (spanning diverse lattice types and space-group families). Building on UniHam, we benchmark two representative state-of-the-art models under a standardized protocol and introduce complementary evaluation metrics that jointly assess three dimensions: (i) Hamiltonian reconstruction accuracy, (ii) out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization across composition/symmetry shifts, and (iii) the ability to support downstream property prediction from the predicted Hamiltonians. Experiments on UniHam demonstrate that the proposed benchmark and metrics effectively differentiate model capabilities, revealing intrinsic SOC- and element-dependent failure modes, large variations in compositional OOD robustness, and the necessity of spectral-level evaluation to assess whether Hamiltonian predictions reliably support downstream electronic-structure properties. Overall, UniHam provides a reproducible, SOC-complete benchmark that can sharpen model comparisons and accelerate the development of next-generation foundation models for quantum materials.

full_list.title_en: Scalable Bayesian Optimization for Efficient Exploration of Moire Patterns
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Scalable Bayesian Optimization for Efficient Exploration of Moire Patterns
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12010v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large materials design spaces often contain rare high-performing configurations that are difficult to identify through trial-and-error exploration or purely representative machine-learning (ML) sampling. In this work, we present FruBO, a flexible Bayesian Optimization framework for accelerating the discovery of optimal configurations in computationally demanding materials design problems. As a case study, we investigate multilayer Moiré patterns generated by the superposition of six rotated hexagonal lattices, where the objective is to identify the rotational conformation that maximizes pore-size uniformity, quantified using the Jain fairness index. The resulting benchmark contains 600,000 unique configurations and exhibits a highly skewed objective distribution, making the global optimum difficult to locate by random sampling. We compare random exploration, Gaussian Process-based Bayesian Optimization, and Bayesian Optimization using a lightweight CatBoost surrogate with committee-based uncertainty estimation. Random sampling identifies the global optimum only after 533,012 evaluations, requiring approximately 31 hours, while Gaussian Process-based BO becomes impractical due to GPU memory exhaustion after 290 acquired samples. In contrast, FruBO with CatBoost identifies the global optimum after 1,470 acquired samples and approximately 1.15 hours. These results demonstrate that scalable surrogate models can substantially improve the feasibility and efficiency of BO in large nanomaterials design spaces.

full_list.title_en: fNIRSAtlas: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Classification
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：fNIRSAtlas: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Classification
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10082v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for brain-computer interfaces and cognitive state decoding, but progress in machine learning for fNIRS has been limited by small, isolated datasets and inconsistent evaluation protocols. We introduce fNIRSAtlas, the largest open benchmark for fNIRS classification to date, comprising 23 classification tasks from 19 public data collections, spanning diverse experimental paradigms, including motor execution, motor imagery, mental arithmetic, working memory, and emotion recognition. fNIRSAtlas provides a fully automated pipeline from raw data to evaluation and defines standardized benchmark tasks for both cross-subject and within-subject classification, ensuring reproducible comparison of methods. We evaluate a variety of baseline models from fNIRS and related neuroimaging and time-series machine learning literature on the benchmark. Our results demonstrate that performance varies substantially across tasks and that methods validated on limited data -- especially deep learning approaches -- often fail to generalize beyond their original evaluation. fNIRSAtlas serves as an extensible, open, and reproducible benchmark to support more robust and cumulative progress in machine learning for fNIRS data. Our code and data can be found at https://fnirsatlas.github.io.

full_list.title_en: MOTIF: LLM-Defined Material Taxonomies for OOD Property Prediction via Invariant Feature Selection
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：MOTIF: LLM-Defined Material Taxonomies for OOD Property Prediction via Invariant Feature Selection
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains a central challenge in materials property prediction, where models must extrapolate to novel chemistries beyond the training distribution. While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong scientific reasoning, their direct use for quantitative prediction remains limited. To address this, we systematically evaluate multiple roles for LLM assistance, finding that only taxonomy-based grouping consistently improves OOD generalization over a strong kNN+GBT baseline. Building on this, we here propose MOTIF, a framework that leverages LLMs not as predictors, but as generators of candidate taxonomies that partition materials into chemically meaningful environments. These taxonomies are evaluated via training-only pseudo-OOD validation, and only those that improve generalization are retained. Invariant feature selection is then applied within each accepted taxonomy, followed by gated aggregation across taxonomies. We evaluate on 2D halide perovskites, where bandgap prediction must generalize across distinct organic spacer families. On this benchmark, MOTIF reduces mean OOD MAE from 0.122 to 0.111 eV. Under a frozen dev/test protocol, the deployable configuration further improves errors from 0.123 to 0.117 eV (electronic bandgap) and from 0.181 to 0.173 eV (optical bandgap). Beyond this primary task, we validate transferability across additional materials datasets, including 3D perovskite solar cell efficiencies and Matbench benchmarks with structure-based splits. Across domains, MOTIF consistently improves robustness under distribution shift, outperforming expert-defined groupings, rule-based heuristics, and clustering baselines, while remaining competitive with strong classical selection methods. These results demonstrate that LLMs are most effective not as predictors, but as tools for discovering structure in data.

full_list.title_en: Spatiotemporal Energy Consistency Enables Reliable Coarse-Grained Molecular Dynamics from Diffusion Models
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Spatiotemporal Energy Consistency Enables Reliable Coarse-Grained Molecular Dynamics from Diffusion Models
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10517v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coarse-grained molecular dynamics (CGMD) extends molecular simulations to length and time scales inaccessible to atomistic models, but building thermodynamically faithful CG potentials remains a longstanding challenge. Energy-based diffusion models (EBDMs) provide a promising route for learning CG potentials through their zero-time energy. However, CGMD driven by diffusion-learned potentials can produce equilibrium ensembles that deviate substantially from the target distribution. We show that the zero-time distribution error is bounded by the sum of the spatial score error and temporal energy-derivative error, whereas conventional diffusion objectives directly supervise only the spatial component. Based on this finding, we introduce Spatiotemporal Energy Consistency (STEC) supervision, which complements spatial score matching by explicitly constraining temporal energy derivatives. We derive an exact and tractable objective for this temporal component, avoiding the substantial computational overhead associated with previous regularization schemes. Across peptide and fast-folding protein systems, STEC-trained EBDMs accurately reproduce equilibrium distributions with free-energy errors within chemical accuracy, while supporting stable long-time simulations that recover key metastable transition patterns. On held-out octapeptides, STEC reduces free-energy errors by more than 5-fold relative to the strongest competing baseline, while achieving a median production-cost reduction of approximately 1,700-fold relative to atomistic molecular dynamics under a defined structural-coverage benchmark. These results establish STEC as a scalable framework for learning thermodynamically reliable CG force fields for increasingly complex biomolecular systems.

full_list.title_en: Benchmarking language models and agents for scientific reasoning in evolving materials laboratories
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Benchmarking language models and agents for scientific reasoning in evolving materials laboratories
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12014v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models and the multi-agent systems built around them could accelerate materials discovery by connecting scientific knowledge with experimental decisions. Existing benchmarks establish capabilities in domain knowledge, multimodal interpretation and scientific tool use. As language models increasingly support materials research workflows, their ability to distinguish closely related material states and reason accurately with quantitative evidence remains insufficiently evaluated. These abilities are essential for comparing material responses, assessing mechanisms and maintaining reliable judgements as experimental evidence accumulates. We introduce MatScope to evaluate three connected capabilities. M1 tests unaided, condition-specific reasoning through 200 tasks spanning ten research functions, using aluminium and high-entropy alloys as representative material systems. M2 tests agent-assisted transfer of related knowledge to unresolved materials questions. MatEvoBench-20 tests initial forecasts across scientific dependency chains and revisions of still-hidden responses as observations accumulate. Across eleven model deployments, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, given-input calculations and many physical explanations are handled well. Fine-grained response estimates, comparisons between similar states and quantitatively supported choices remain substantially weaker. Related literature improves selected estimates, while condition and baseline mismatches limit transfer. Progressive observations calibrate some downstream responses and destabilize earlier accurate predictions. MatScope establishes measurable targets for developing reliable scientific reasoning in future self-evolving materials laboratories and materials-aware world models.

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的晶体结构搜索、高通量筛选和材料信息学嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在新型铁电、磁性、钙钛矿、二维和能源材料候选中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“用 ML 代理能量和不确定性缩小结构搜索，再对候选做对称性、动力学稳定性、极化/磁序和有限温度筛选，避免只按 0 K 单点能排序”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Benchmarking language models and agents for scientific reasoning in evolving materials laboratories》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Orbital texture of valence band and interband transitions of the type-II multiferroic van der Waals NiI₂
full_list.title_zh: II 型多铁范德华 NiI2 的价带和带间跃迁的轨道结构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11425v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: NiI₂ is a van der Waals semiconductor characterized by complex electronic and magnetic phases, holding promise towards functional applications. For this purpose, a detailed understanding of its band structure and its excitations is essential to elucidate the electronic and transport properties. We present a comprehensive description of the band structure and of the lowest valence-to-conduction band transition in bulk NiI₂, by means of time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy supported by first-principles calculations. We describe the orbital character of Ni and I manifolds, and identify the main momentum-resolved features of the valence band and the shallow minima of the conduction band. With this study, we provide a foundational understanding of the electronic structure of NiI₂ and its single-particle interband electronic excitation, a benchmark for theoretical models, and a framework for future investigations on this material.
full_list.abstract_zh: NiI2 是一种范德华半导体，具有复杂的电子相和磁相，有望实现功能应用。为此，详细了解其能带结构及其激发对于阐明电子和传输特性至关重要。我们通过第一性原理计算支持的时间和角度分辨光电子能谱，对块状 NiI2 中的能带结构和最低价态到导带的跃迁进行了全面的描述。我们描述了 Ni 和 I 流形的轨道特征，并确定了价带和导带浅极小值的主要动量分辨特征。

full_list.title_en: Atomically abrupt sp-sp² all-carbon heterojunction preserving the electronic identity of constituent allotropes
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Atomically abrupt sp-sp² all-carbon heterojunction preserving the electronic identity of constituent allotropes
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10272v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Covalently integrating distinct carbon allotropes with atomic precision remains, to date, elusive, despite the clear advantage of combining complementary functionalities while preserving their electronic identities. Here, we realize an all-carbon lateral heterojunction combining (sp²) armchair graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) and sp-sp² hydrogenated graphdiyne (hGDY) on Au(111) through Fe-mediated hierarchical on-surface synthesis. Low-temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy combined with density-functional theory reveal an atomically abrupt (<0.5 nm), asymmetric type-I interface. Redistribution of an edge-localized GNR state onto the first hGDY unit demonstrates local electronic continuity, whereas their characteristic electronic structures re-emerge immediately beyond the interface. Calculations further indicate that heterojunction formation weakens the interaction of both constituents with the underlying Au(111) substrate, widening their gaps and reducing adsorption-induced interfacial polarization. These results establish lateral covalent integration as a route to engineer atomically defined electronic interfaces and substrate coupling in all-carbon nanostructures.

full_list.title_en: Connate Topological Superconductivity and Vortex-Position-Controlled Majorana Modes in the Intergrowth Superconductor Th₂Mo₂Ir₂Si₄C
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Connate Topological Superconductivity and Vortex-Position-Controlled Majorana Modes in the Intergrowth Superconductor Th₂Mo₂Ir₂Si₄C
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12080v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recently synthesized intergrowth compound Th₂Mo₂Ir₂Si₄C is an experimentally established bulk superconductor whose topological electronic structure remains unexplored. Here, we identify it as a candidate for connate topological superconductivity and reveal two microscopic routes to vortex Majorana zero modes. First-principles and tight-binding-model calculations uncover Mo--Th band inversion and helical surface states enabled by interorbital spin--orbit coupling between Mo--dₓz/yz and Th--dₓ^₂₋y^₂ orbitals. Vortex Bogoliubov--de Gennes calculations further establish a relatively robust surface-state-associated Kitaev phase and a weakly gapped, Th-orbital-derived Kitaev phase. For the latter, shifting the vortex core closes and reopens the vortex-line gap and reverses its one-dimensional topological invariant, consistent with an effective Kitaev-chain mass inversion. Finite-length-vortex calculations reveal distinct spatial and spin-resolved signatures of their Majorana end modes. The orbital Kitaev phase can also exist without helical surface states in a modified model. Although the small orbital-derived gap limits quantitative predictions of experimental observability in this compound, the uncovered mechanism suggests a route to Majorana vortices in multiorbital superconductors beyond the conventional surface-state scenario.

full_list.title_en: Markov-Shielded Typicality for Thermal Quantum States
full_list.title_zh: 热量子态的马尔可夫屏蔽典型性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10593v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pure states of quantum many-body systems at thermal equilibrium are known to be typical, in a sense that a randomly chosen pure state from an appropriate energy shell reproduces the Gibbs-state expectation values of most observables acting on a small subsystem. However, such typical states are intrinsically stochastic, conventionally generated from the random high-temperature state, suffer from statistical fluctuations, and do not provide a continuous connection to the ground state. Here, we introduce a deterministic variational framework for constructing a Markov-Shielded Typical (MST) state, a unique thermal pure-state representative whose local reduced density matrices closely approximate those of the Gibbs state, from the ground state up to infinite-temperature limit. Our approach reformulates free-energy minimization by replacing the nonlocal von Neumann entropy with a local, computationally tractable Markov entropy, where we establish rigorous upper and lower bounds of MST free energy to lie in the very vicinity of the thermal free energy. This framework extends the concept of typicality to deterministic pure-state representations of thermal equilibrium, offering a scalable wave-function approach with potential applications to both classical and quantum computing.
full_list.abstract_zh: 已知热平衡时的量子多体系统的纯态是典型的，从某种意义上说，从适当的能量壳中随机选择的纯态再现了作用于小子系统的大多数可观测量的吉布斯态期望值。然而，这种典型的状态本质上是随机的，通常是由随机高温状态生成的，受到统计波动的影响，并且不提供与基态的连续连接。在这里，我们引入了一个确定性变分框架，用于构造马尔可夫屏蔽典型（MST）态，这是一种独特的热纯态代表，其局部约简密度矩阵非常接近吉布斯态，从基态到无限温度极限。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 已知热平衡时的量子多体系统的纯态是典型的，从某种意义上说，从适当的能量壳中随机选择的纯态再现了作用于小子系统的大多数可观测量的吉布斯态期望值。然而，这种典型的状态本质上是随机的，通常是由随机高温状态生成的，受到统计波动的影响，并且不提供与基态的连续连接。在这里，我们引入了一个确定性变分框架，用于构造马尔可夫屏蔽典型（MST）态，这是一种独特的热纯态代表，其局部约简密度矩阵非常接近吉布斯态，从基态到无限温度极限。我们的方法通过用局部的、可计算处理的马尔可夫熵替换非局部冯·诺依曼熵来重新表述自由能最小化，其中我们建立了严格的 MST 自由能上限和下限，使其位于热自由能的附近。该框架将典型性的概念扩展到热平衡的确定性纯态表示，提供了一种可扩展的波函数方法，具有在经典计算和量子计算中的潜在应用。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：自由能面和热力学积分/采样，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《热量子态的马尔可夫屏蔽典型性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Out-of-plane interference effects in the angle-resolved photoemission of epitaxial graphene
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Out-of-plane interference effects in the angle-resolved photoemission of epitaxial graphene
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The epitaxial growth of monolayer graphene by Si sublimation of 6H-SiC(0001) is one of the most effective ways of producing large-scale monocrystalline graphene samples of high quality. However, graphene is left interacting with a reconstructed carbon buffer layer known as zerolayer graphene (ZLG) and the SiC substrate underneath. Beyond the mere creation of Dirac cone replicas, the effect of this interaction on photoemission measurements is poorly understood. We utilized synchrotron radiation for photon-energy-dependent angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) to investigate the complex final-state interactions of photoelectrons within the heterostructure of monolayer graphene, ZLG, and SiC. We identify multiple resonances in the photoemission intensity of the Dirac cone as a function of photon energy that originate from interlayer interference, confirmed with a multiple scattering model. We also demonstrate for the first time that the relative intensity of the replica bands induced by the (6sqrt3 × 6sqrt3)R30^circ reconstruction scales with the electron kinetic energy. Finally, we resolved four nondispersing electronic states, which originate from the ZLG. Our findings show that the three-dimensional (3D) structure of SiC and ZLG manifests itself in the photoemission from two-dimensional (2D) epitaxial graphene. By revealing how 3D substrate architecture dictates the photoemission of a 2D layer, this work establishes a crucial framework for investigating the electronic structure of complex heterostructures via ARPES.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Roadmap on Nanoscale Superconductivity for Quantum Technologies
full_list.title_zh: 量子技术纳米级超导路线图
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In 2025, the Year of Quantum Science and Technology, we celebrate a century of quantum mechanics, witnessing a surge in activities that illuminate its inherent strangeness and drive technological innovation. Superconductivity, discovered 114 years ago, stands as a prime example, offering direct and compelling evidence of macroscopic quantum phenomena. Beyond its ability to conduct immense currents without loss, superconductivity reveals the quantum realm operating on a scale we can directly observe and manipulate. The macroscopic quantum coherence, where an ensemble of particles is described by a single wave function, leads to remarkable consequences: dissipation-less current and flux quantization - the basic properties exploited in superconducting quantum circuit fabrication. This Roadmap has been inspired by intensive discussions and collaborations emerging from the European COST Action CA21144 (SuperQuMap - Superconducting Nanodevices and Quantum Materials for Coherent Manipulation). The roadmap outlines the network's concrete activities, driving advancements in superconductor-based quantum technologies and charting future directions. Spanning fundamental research to practical applications, the roadmap incorporates insights from industry partners developing quantum computation. It begins by exploring quantum materials, highlighting how topology and electronic correlations could catalyze a quantum leap in technology. We then delve into manipulating the superconducting phase, leveraging advancements in magnetism, 3D fabrication, and tunable correlations. Further, we showcase the advanced microscopy techniques - such as angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and scanning probes - used to visualize quantum behavior. Finally, and crucially, we detail the quantum devices developed within the network, and their transformative impact on modern quantum computing approaches.
full_list.abstract_zh: 2025 年是量子科学技术年，我们庆祝量子力学百年，见证了一系列活动的激增，这些活动阐明了其固有的奇异性并推动了技术创新。 114 年前发现的超导性就是一个典型的例子，为宏观量子现象提供了直接且令人信服的证据。除了能够无损耗地传导巨大电流之外，超导性还揭示了我们可以直接观察和操纵的量子领域。宏观量子相干性（其中粒子集合由单个波函数描述）会产生显着的后果：无耗散电流和通量量子化 - 超导量子电路制造中利用的基本特性。

full_list.title_en: Spin Conductivity: Insight From Perturbation Theory
full_list.title_zh: 自旋电导率：微扰理论的见解
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11077v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The investigation on the spin conductivity has now been blooming in burgeoning altermagnetic materials. Here, an alternative and elementary derivation for the spin conductivity expression is presented. This is done within the context of perturbation theory. It indicates that our derived expression for the T-even (T for time reversal) spin conductivity agrees exactly with those derived from the Kubo linear response theory and quantum kinetic theory. In addition, the expression for the T-odd spin conductivity in the clean limit is exactly consistent with those presented previously. We show that the T-odd (T-even) spin conductivity arises from the contribution of zeroth-order (first-order) wave function correction. Our work provides some physical insight into the spin conductivity from the perturbation theory and shines more light on the charge-to-spin conversion mechanism in magnetic materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 自旋电导率的研究现已在新兴的交流磁材料中蓬勃发展。这里，提出了自旋传导表达式的另一种基本推导。这是在微扰理论的背景下完成的。这表明我们导出的 T-even（T 为时间反转）自旋电导率表达式与 Kubo 线性响应理论和量子动力学理论导出的表达式完全一致。此外，清洁极限下的T奇自旋电导率的表达式与之前提出的完全一致。我们证明了 T 奇（T 偶）自旋电导率是由零阶（一阶）波函数校正的贡献产生的。

full_list.title_en: Spin-valve effect through electrostatic coupling
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Spin-valve effect through electrostatic coupling
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12588v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a spin-valve effect in which an insulating magnetic van der Waals multilayer controls the conductance of an adjacent non-magnetic conductor by electrostatic coupling, without transport-electrons entering the magnetic layers. The coupling is induced by the variations of the electronic structure when the relative orientation of the magnetization of adjacent monolayers changes from parallel to antiparallel, modifying both the dielectric constant and band alignment. We consider two types of coupling and device concepts: charge transfer to a graphene monolayer and capacitive coupling in a single-electron transistor. We use density functional calculations to assess the magnitude of the effect in various materials, including CrI₃, CrBr₃, CrCl₃ and NiBr₂. We predict magnetoresistance ratios in the range of 1.14-1.20 for the charge-transfer device and up to 10³ in the single-electron transistor.

full_list.title_en: Tuning correlated states in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene with magnetic encapsulation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Tuning correlated states in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene with magnetic encapsulation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12281v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rhombohedral graphene multilayers provide a flexible platform for correlated physics associated with their flat-band electronic structure.While a variety of correlated states appear in these systems as a function of bias and electrostatic doping, promoting specific correlated flavor symmetry breaking states remains a challenge. Here we show that magnetic encapsulation by CrGeTe₃ achieves this in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene, by using switchable exchange couplings induced by ferromagnetic substrates. We show that correlations in rhombohedral multilayers at charge neutrality strongly renormalize the exchange proximity splitting,giving rise to collective spin modes whose character is switched by the parallel or antiparallel alignment of the encapsulation. We further show that upon doping of the flat bands, spin triplet f-wave superconducting solutions emerge, whose layer and spin selectivity is controlled by the magnetic encapsulation, hosting in-gap excitations at the edges. Our results establish magnetic alignment as a means to control spin symmetry breaking and unconventional superconductivity in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene.

full_list.title_en: Anharmonic lattice dynamics and superconductivity in strained bulk and surface niobium
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Anharmonic lattice dynamics and superconductivity in strained bulk and surface niobium
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.02730v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Using first-principles calculations, we investigate how homogeneous strain and crystallographic surface orientation modify the vibrational and superconducting properties of niobium. For bulk Nb, tensile strain strongly softens the phonon spectrum and enhances the electron--phonon coupling, increasing the superconducting transition temperature from 9.5 K at equilibrium to 14.5 K at sim!6% lattice expansion. For the low-index Nb(001), Nb(110), and Nb(111) surfaces, harmonic phonon calculations exhibit imaginary modes, showing that anharmonic lattice effects are essential. To treat these effects efficiently, we train Nb-specific machine-learning interatomic potentials on bulk and slab first-principles configurations and use them to accelerate stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation calculations, thereby obtaining anharmonically renormalized phonon modes that are combined with density-functional perturbation theory electron--phonon matrix elements to construct the Eliashberg spectral function. Among the clean free-standing slabs considered here, Nb(001) exhibits the strongest electron--phonon coupling and the highest calculated transition temperature of 10.0 K, while Nb(110) and Nb(111) show progressively reduced pairing strength. Finally, by analyzing the Eliashberg spectral function and the functional derivative δ T_c/δα²F(ω), we identify the phonon energy ranges most effective for superconducting pairing. Our results show that strain, surface termination, and anharmonic phonon renormalization provide complementary and interrelated microscopic routes for tuning superconductivity in Nb.

full_list.title_en: Extending the reach of real-space real-time TDDFT: new developments in the Octopus code
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Extending the reach of real-space real-time TDDFT: new developments in the Octopus code
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12018v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Octopus is an open-source package implementing time-dependent density functional theory in a real-space, real-time formulation. Here we report on the developments since our previous contribution to the Special Topic Issue on Electronic Structure Software [J. Chem. Phys. 152, 124119 (2020)]. New exchange-correlation functionals extend the range of systems that can be treated, while advances in relativistic and all-electron methods open the door to core-electron spectroscopy. New capabilities for lattice dynamics - stress-tensor calculation, geometry optimization, support for machine-learned force fields, and phonon calculations - enable a fully ab initio description of light-induced lattice dynamics in real time. We also present developments that move beyond the dipole approximation, capturing light-matter interaction more faithfully. Improved methods for exciton dynamics complement a set of algorithmic advances - new propagation schemes, imaginary-time evolution, and a refactored grid handling more than a billion points - that together substantially improve performance and scalability. Combined with technical improvements such as AMD GPU support and a modernized build system, these developments consolidate Octopus as a versatile, high-performance platform for exploring electronic excitations, light-matter interaction, and nonequilibrium dynamics in molecules, nanostructures, and extended systems.

full_list.title_en: Harmonic origin of local symmetry breaking in PbTe revealed using machine-learned potentials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Harmonic origin of local symmetry breaking in PbTe revealed using machine-learned potentials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12598v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use machine-learned interatomic potentials combined with higher-order interatomic force constant models to show that finite-range polar correlations in PbTe are driven by long-range harmonic interactions rather than lattice anharmonicity. Our molecular dynamics simulations reveal a spatial polar correlation range exceeding 50 Å at low temperatures and decreasing with increasing temperature. Selective interatomic force constant mapping demonstrates that crystal anharmonicity usually associated with the formation of polar nanoregions suppresses polar correlations. Instead, long-range harmonic interactions extending to 13 Å are necessary to reproduce the spatial coherence of local dipoles. In reciprocal space, these extended harmonic interactions correspond to high curvature of the transverse optical (TO) phonon branch at the Γ point. Comparison with isostructural NaCl connects these extended interactions to local underscreening of predominantly Coulombic forces. Our results provide a key microscopic description of finite-range polar correlations and a framework for understanding local symmetry breaking in centrosymmetric materials.

full_list.title_en: Kagome Flat Bands from Self-Assembled Water on Non-van der Waals 2D Materials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Kagome Flat Bands from Self-Assembled Water on Non-van der Waals 2D Materials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12371v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The properties of two-dimensional (2D) materials are governed not only by their intrinsic electronic structure but also in particular by their surface chemistry and interactions with the environment. The surfaces of non-van der Waals (non-vdW) 2D materials are intrinsically reactive and may require chemical stabilization under realistic experimental conditions. Here, we perform a systematic first-principles study of water passivation of non-vdW 2D materials and demonstrate that molecular water adsorption is energetically and dynamically favored for a wide range of systems. Rather than dissociating, water molecules frequently remain intact and form adsorbed ordered surface overlayers. These overlayers can adopt a kagome lattice geometry, leading to the emergence of flat electronic bands directly at the valence-band edge. Analysis of the electronic structure reveals a strong intermolecular coupling between neighboring water lone pairs within this kagome topology, while the locked molecular orientations simultaneously produce an electrostatically frustrated surface potential. These findings establish water not only as a stabilizing agent but also as an active element for electronic structure engineering of non-vdW 2D surfaces.

full_list.title_en: Anharmonicity Driven by Vacancy Ordering Unlocks High-performance Thermoelectric Conversion in Defective Chalcopyrites II-III₂-VI₄
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Anharmonicity Driven by Vacancy Ordering Unlocks High-performance Thermoelectric Conversion in Defective Chalcopyrites II-III₂-VI₄
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.16477v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Defective chalcopyrites have recently emerged as promising thermoelectric materials because their ordered intrinsic vacancies can profoundly reshape both lattice dynamics and electronic structure. Here, we present a comprehensive theoretical investigation of the lattice thermal and carrier transport properties of II-III₂-VI₄ defective chalcopyrites by combining first-principles calculations with machine-learning interatomic potentials. We show that vacancy ordering enhances lattice distortion, leading to strong anharmonicity and metavalent bonding. The interplay of soft low-frequency phonons, strongly negative Grüneisen parameters, and a substantially enlarged four-phonon scattering phase space results in four-phonon-scattering-dominated heat transport, yielding ultralow lattice thermal conductivity. Meanwhile, systematic anion substitution at the VI-site provides an effective route to tune the electronic structure: reduced anion electronegativity weakens metal-anion hybridization, shifts anion p states upward, narrows the band gap, and thereby improves electrical transport. Benefiting from this synergy between vacancy-induced phonon suppression and anion-regulated electronic optimization, CdGa₂Te₄ exhibits an ultralow lattice thermal conductivity of 0.19 W·m⁻¹K⁻¹ and a high room-temperature ZT of 0.957. This work not only predicts defective chalcopyrites as a promising platform for high-performance thermoelectrics but also provides a practical design strategy by integrating vacancy ordering, higher-order phonon scattering, and anion-dependent band engineering.

full_list.title_en: Exact many-body wavefunction of the Kondo model with time-dependent interaction strength
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Exact many-body wavefunction of the Kondo model with time-dependent interaction strength
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2509.05640v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum integrability has been applied to a large variety of low dimensional Hamiltonians in Quantum Field Theory, Condensed Matter Physics, and Statistical Mechanics to obtain exact expressions for the spectrum and thermodynamics of these systems. In most of these studies the coupling constants are constant in time. Here we present an exact solution of the nonstationary Schrödinger equation for the Kondo Hamiltonian with a time-dependent spin-exchange coupling J(t) of the form λ t + p(t) ± sqrt(λ t + p(t))² + 16/3, where p(t) is an arbitrary periodic function, under periodic boundary conditions. Unlike previously studied time-dependent integrable models, which are rooted in the classical Yang--Baxter structure and associated Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov equations, our approach is based on the quantum Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov framework and the quantum Yang--Baxter algebra. Our results broaden the domain of time-dependent integrability to a genuinely quantum class of models and provide new tools for exploring coherent nonequilibrium dynamics in strongly correlated systems.

full_list.title_en: Dipolar Exchange and Emergent Electric-Dipole-Carrying Quasiparticles in Electronic Ferroelectrics
full_list.title_zh: 电子铁电体中的偶极交换和新兴电偶极子携带准粒子
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic correlations underpin diverse spontaneously ordered states in matter, whose collective excitations emerge as quasiparticles that encode the underlying order. While spin exchange interactions give rise to magnetic order and its quasiparticle excitations known as magnons, their counterparts in electronic ferroelectrics remain poorly understood. Here, we derive an analogous quantum dipolar-pseudospin exchange model for electronic ferroelectricity and identify the associated bosonic quasiparticles that carry intrinsic electric dipole moments. Unlike ferrons in conventional lattice-based ferroelectrics, these dipolar quasiparticles arise entirely from collective electronic dynamics without involving lattice vibrations. Their excitation spectrum exhibits a linear Stark shift under a static electric field, while coupling to an oscillating electric field enables their coherent excitation, leading to colossal, resonantly enhanced second-harmonic generation and optical rectification in the terahertz regime. These dipolar quasiparticles offer promising opportunities for electrically tunable nonlinear optics and open a route toward extending the paradigm of transport in electronic systems beyond conventional charge currents to electric dipole currents.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电子相关性支撑着物质中多种自发有序状态，其集体激发表现为编码潜在顺序的准粒子。虽然自旋交换相互作用产生磁序及其称为磁振子的准粒子激发，但它们在电子铁电体中的对应物仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们推导了电子铁电性的类似量子偶极-赝自旋交换模型，并识别了携带固有电偶极矩的相关玻色准粒子。与传统晶格铁电体中的铁子不同，这些偶极准粒子完全由集体电子动力学产生，不涉及晶格振动。
