full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《电子铁电体中的偶极交换和新兴电偶极子携带准粒子》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Dopant Cluster Engineering for Tunable Room-Temperature Ferromagnetism in 2D Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
full_list.title_zh: 二维过渡金属二硫化物中可调谐室温铁磁性的掺杂团簇工程
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10480v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (2D-TMDs) offer a promising platform for realizing dilute magnetic semiconductors. However, simultaneously achieving large magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) and high Curie temperature (T_c) remains a major challenge. In this work, we employ DFT+U to systematically investigate the thermodynamic stability and magnetic properties of 2D-MoSe₂ and 2D-WSe₂ doped with transition metal atoms. We found that the paired dopant configurations are more stable than previously attributed isolated dopants. Despite their nearly identical crystal structures, 2D-MoSe₂ and 2D-WSe₂ show contrasting properties upon doping. All paired dopants in 2D-MoSe₂ exhibit long-range ferromagnetic coupling (FMC) primarily due to carrier-mediated exchange interactions, whereas those in 2D-WSe₂ show weak exchange coupling. Interestingly, 2Mn₂W shows a transition from less stable antiferromagnetic coupling (AFMC) in the short range to highly stable FMC in the long-range. The combined effect of spin-orbit coupling, exchange interactions, and orbital hybridization gives rise to a large MAE with maximum in-plane values of -3.5 meV for 2V₂Mo and -3.2 meV for 2Mn₂W. Monte Carlo simulations estimate T_c simeq 440 K for 2Fe₂Mo and ensure its high-temperature stability in 2D-MoSe₂. Our results establish dopant clustering as an effective route to engineer high-temperature ferromagnetism in 2D-TMDs and highlight their potential for nano-spintronic applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 二维过渡金属二硫属化物（2D-TMD）为实现稀磁半导体提供了一个有前途的平台。然而，同时实现大磁各向异性能量（MAE）和高居里温度（T_c）仍然是一个主要挑战。在这项工作中，我们采用DFT+U系统地研究了掺杂过渡金属原子的2D-MoSe2和2D-WSe2的热力学稳定性和磁性能。我们发现成对的掺杂剂构型比之前归因的孤立掺杂剂更稳定。尽管 2D-MoSe2 和 2D-WSe2 的晶体结构几乎相同，但它们在掺杂时表现出截然不同的特性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 二维过渡金属二硫属化物（2D-TMD）为实现稀磁半导体提供了一个有前途的平台。然而，同时实现大磁各向异性能量（MAE）和高居里温度（T_c）仍然是一个主要挑战。在这项工作中，我们采用DFT+U系统地研究了掺杂过渡金属原子的2D-MoSe2和2D-WSe2的热力学稳定性和磁性能。我们发现成对的掺杂剂构型比之前归因的孤立掺杂剂更稳定。尽管 2D-MoSe2 和 2D-WSe2 的晶体结构几乎相同，但它们在掺杂时表现出截然不同的特性。 2D-MoSe2 中的所有成对掺杂剂均表现出长程铁磁耦合 (FMC)，这主要是由于载流子介导的交换相互作用，而 2D-WSe2 中的掺杂剂则表现出弱交换耦合。有趣的是，2Mn2W 显示出从短程中不太稳定的反铁磁耦合 (AFMC) 到长程中高度稳定的 FMC 的转变。自旋轨道耦合、交换相互作用和轨道杂化的综合作用产生了较大的 MAE，2V2Mo 的最大面内值为 -3.5 meV，2Mn2W 的最大面内值为 -3.2 meV。蒙特卡洛模拟估计 2Fe 2 Mo 的 T_c simeq 为 440 K，并确保其在 2D-MoSe 2 中的高温稳定性。我们的研究结果表明，掺杂剂团簇是在 2D-TMD 中设计高温铁磁性的有效途径，并强调了它们在纳米自旋电子应用中的潜力。

full_list.title_en: Effect of Correlation on the Pressure-Induced Insulator to Metal Transition in Complex Spin-Orbit Coupled Double Perovskite La₂CoIr₁₋ₓTiₓO₆
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Effect of Correlation on the Pressure-Induced Insulator to Metal Transition in Complex Spin-Orbit Coupled Double Perovskite La₂CoIr₁₋ₓTiₓO₆
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11253v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the effect of electron correlation (U) and hydrostatic pressure on the electronic properties of double perovskites La₂CoIr₁₋ₓTiₓO₆ for x = 0, 0.5, and 1, using first-principles electronic structure calculations within density functional theory (DFT). At ambient pressure, we systematically vary the electron correlation, i.e., on-site Coulomb interaction to study its effect on band gap and structural parameters. Increasing the value of U enhances the band gap of all three compositions while producing only a slight variation in structural parameters. The effect of hydrostatic pressure is also studied for the same compositions. The estimated band gap values at ambient pressure closes at approximately 39, 42, and 53 GPa for x = 0 (for U_Co = 5 eV and U_Ir = 2 eV), 0.5 (for U_Co = 5 eV and U_Ir = 2 eV), and 1 (for U_Co = 4 eV), respectively, indicating pressure-induced insulator-to-metal transitions. These results show that electron correlation stabilises the insulating state, whereas hydrostatic pressure favours the metallic state by closing the band gap. These findings highlight the tunability of correlated oxides through electron correlations and pressure, offering insights for materials design.

full_list.title_en: Enhancement of the magnetorheological effect using discontinuous shear thickening with a mixture of magnetic and non magnetic particles
full_list.title_zh: 使用磁性和非磁性颗粒的混合物进行不连续剪切增稠增强磁流变效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09970v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The phenomenon of discontinuous shear thickening (DST) is observed in suspensions of solid particles with a very high-volume fraction. Using a suspension of magnetic particles at high-volume fraction we have, for the first time, demonstrated experimentally the presence of a frictional network of particles by a simultaneous measurement of the electrical resistance of the suspension and of the rheological curve. An obstacle for the applications of MRS remains the sedimentation and aggregation linked to the high density of the iron microparticles. We have recently found that a small fraction of ferromagnetic particles within a concentrated suspension of calcium carbonate particles is not only sufficient to trigger the transition by application of a magnetic field but also optimum for the amplitude of the jump in viscosity observed in DST. We shall explain this result from stress transmission between the magnetic particles and nonmagnetic ones, both inserted in the percolated network of particles. We will also highlight the role of the polyelectrolyte adsorbed on the surface of the particles in the DST transition through the balance between the repulsive entropic force between two layers of polymer adsorbed on different particles and the magnetic attraction force.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在具有非常高体积分数的固体颗粒悬浮液中观察到不连续剪切增稠（DST）现象。使用高体积分数的磁性颗粒悬浮液，我们通过同时测量悬浮液的电阻和流变曲线，首次通过实验证明了颗粒摩擦网络的存在。 MRS 应用的一个障碍仍然是与高密度铁微粒相关的沉积和聚集。我们最近发现，碳酸钙颗粒浓缩悬浮液中的一小部分铁磁颗粒不仅足以通过施加磁场来触发转变，而且对于 DST 中观察到的粘度跳跃幅度来说也是最佳的。我们将通过磁性颗粒和非磁性颗粒之间的应力传递来解释这一结果，两者都插入颗粒的渗透网络中。

full_list.title_en: Ferromagnetic resonance signatures of edge states for distinguishing chiral and helical p-wave superconductors
full_list.title_zh: 用于区分手性和螺旋 p 波超导体的边缘态铁磁共振特征
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) modulation at interfaces between ferromagnetic insulators and two-dimensional chiral and helical p-wave superconductors. We evaluate the surface dynamical spin susceptibility, including both edge and bulk quasiparticle excitations. For momentum-conserving interfacial exchange at zero temperature, the edge contribution to the Gilbert damping exhibits distinct frequency scalings for the excitation energies well above the spectral broadening, hbarωgg2δ: δ/(hbarω)² for the chiral state and 1/hbarω for the helical state. For a clean superconducting boundary, edge-induced Ising spin anisotropy persists even when interfacial exchange disorder randomizes momentum transfer. The low-energy edge response is suppressed when the magnetization aligns with the edge-state spin axis. These results establish FMR modulation as a probe complementary to existing methods for distinguishing the chiral and helical states and constraining their d-vector directions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上研究了铁磁绝缘体与二维手性和螺旋 p 波超导体之间界面的铁磁共振 (FMR) 调制。我们评估表面动态自旋敏感性，包括边缘和体准粒子激发。对于零温度下的动量守恒界面交换，吉尔伯特阻尼的边缘贡献表现出远高于光谱展宽的激发能量的明显频率缩放，hbarωgg2δ：手性态为 δ/(hbarω)2，螺旋态为 1/hbarω。对于干净的超导边界，即使界面交换无序使动量传递随机化，边缘引起的伊辛自旋各向异性仍然存在。当磁化强度与边缘态自旋轴对齐时，低能边缘响应被抑制。

full_list.title_en: Frustrated Magnetism from Dimerized S = 1/2 Co²⁺ in Rose-Phase Na₂CoP₂O₇
full_list.title_zh: 玫瑰相 Na2CoP2O₇ 中二聚化 S = 1/2 Co²⁺ 的受挫磁性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11772v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the growth of high-quality single crystals and the magnetic, thermodynamic, and dielectric properties of rose-phase Na₂CoP₂O₇, a low-symmetry magnet in which corner-sharing Co²⁺ dimers form an approximately triangular network. Magnetic measurements reveal dominant antiferromagnetic interactions and pronounced anisotropy among effective S=1/2 Co²⁺ moments. Broad low-temperature maxima in the magnetic susceptibility and heat capacity suggest the development of short-range magnetic correlations below approximately 4 K. The large separation between the absolute Curie--Weiss temperatures and the characteristic correlation temperature indicates strong magnetic frustration arising from competing interactions within the coupled-dimer network. Applied magnetic fields suppress these anomalies and reduce the recovered magnetic entropy, suggesting further enhancement of frustration under field. A systematic magnetodielectric response closely follows the field dependence of the magnetization, indicating coupling between magnetic and dielectric degrees of freedom. The low lattice symmetry enables multiple inequivalent exchange pathways and anisotropic interactions while relaxing symmetry constraints on coupling among spin, lattice, and dielectric degrees of freedom. These results establish rose-phase Na₂CoP₂O₇ as a platform for exploring frustrated quantum magnetism and coupled functionalities in effective S=1/2 magnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们报告了高质量单晶的生长以及玫瑰相Na ₂ CoP ₂ O恤的磁性、热力学和介电性能，这是一种低对称磁体，其中角共用Co ²恤二聚体形成近似三角形的网络。磁学测量揭示了有效S = 1/2 Co ² ”矩之间的主要反铁磁相互作用和显着的各向异性。磁化率和热容量方面的广泛低温最大值表明，在大约4 K以下会发展短程磁相关性。绝对居里-魏斯温度和特征相关性温度之间的较大分离表明，耦合二聚体网络内相互竞争的相互作用产生了强烈的磁挫折。

full_list.title_en: Hidden memory above the Neel temperature programs antiferromagnetic order in Cr2O3
full_list.title_zh: 高于尼尔温度的隐藏记忆在 Cr2O3 中编程反铁磁顺序
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10173v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Control of antiferromagnetic order is central to magnetoelectric and antiferromagnetic spintronic devices. In the prototypical magnetoelectric antiferromagnet Cr2O3, domains are conventionally selected by simultaneous application of electric and magnetic fields during cooling through the Neel temperature (T_N) or at a fixed temperature below T_N. Here, we show that antiferromagnetic order can instead be programmed by electric-field conditioning entirely in the paramagnetic state above T_N. By measuring the magnetoelectric coefficient (alpha_zz) of bulk Cr2O3 crystals under different thermal and field histories, we find that a sufficiently large electric field above T_N establishes a reversible state that persists after the field is removed. Subsequent magnetic-field cooling with no applied electric field produces a single-domain state with the opposite Neel-vector orientation from conventional magnetoelectric field cooling. The electrically induced state can be reversibly written, erased, and allowed to relax at high temperatures, demonstrating a long-lived internal electric bias that governs domain selection. The observed behavior is consistent with a metastable surface-associated polar state that may generate this internal bias. These results reveal an unexpected coupling between electrically programmed memory and antiferromagnetic domain formation in Cr2O3.
full_list.abstract_zh: 反铁磁序的控制是磁电和反铁磁自旋电子器件的核心。在原型磁电反铁磁体 Cr2O3 中，通常通过在冷却至尼尔温度 (T_N) 或低于 T_N 的固定温度期间同时施加电场和磁场来选择磁畴。在这里，我们证明反铁磁序可以通过完全在 T_N 以上的顺磁状态下的电场调节来编程。通过测量块状 Cr2O3 晶体在不同热历史和场历史下的磁电系数 (alpha_zz)，我们发现 T_N 以上足够大的电场建立了可逆状态，该状态在电场移除后仍然存在。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁序的控制是磁电和反铁磁自旋电子器件的核心。在原型磁电反铁磁体 Cr2O3 中，通常通过在冷却至尼尔温度 (T_N) 或低于 T_N 的固定温度期间同时施加电场和磁场来选择磁畴。在这里，我们证明反铁磁序可以通过完全在 T_N 以上的顺磁状态下的电场调节来编程。通过测量块状 Cr2O3 晶体在不同热历史和场历史下的磁电系数 (alpha_zz)，我们发现 T_N 以上足够大的电场建立了可逆状态，该状态在电场移除后仍然存在。随后在不施加电场的情况下进行磁场冷却，产生与传统磁电场冷却相反的尼尔矢量方向的单畴态。电感应状态可以可逆地写入、擦除，并可以在高温下松弛，从而证明了控制域选择的长寿命内部电偏压。观察到的行为与可能产生这种内部偏差的亚稳态表面相关极性状态一致。这些结果揭示了电编程存储器与 Cr2O3 中反铁磁畴形成之间的意外耦合。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《高于尼尔温度的隐藏记忆在 Cr2O3 中编程反铁磁顺序》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Magnetotropic signatures of Fulde-Ferrell Pairing in a Pauli-limited superconductor
full_list.title_zh: Pauli-受限超导体中Fulde-Ferrell配对的向磁性特征
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12032v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Resonant torsion magnetometry measures the angular curvature of the free energy and is sensitive to magnetic anisotropy. We calculate its response for a clean Pauli-limited superconductor with single-plane-wave Fulde-Ferrell pairing. Field rotation drives a first-order transition from the uniform condensate into the finite-momentum phase and a continuous transition into the normal state. The first-order line produces a sharp softening whose integrated weight is fixed by the magnetization jump, so the dip alone does not identify finite momentum. The distinguishing response is a broad softening inside the Fulde-Ferrell phase, caused by relaxation of the gap and pairing momentum, followed by a finite step at the upper critical field.
full_list.abstract_zh: 共振扭转磁强计测量自由能的角曲率，对磁各向异性敏感。我们计算了具有单平面波Fulde-Ferrell配对的干净的泡利限制超导体的响应。场旋转驱动从均匀冷凝物到有限动量相的一阶过渡，并连续过渡到正常状态。一阶线产生锐利软化，其积分重量由磁化跳跃固定，因此仅倾斜不能识别有限动量。区别性反应是Fulde-Ferrell相内广泛的软化，由间隙的松弛和配对动量引起，然后在上临界场的有限步骤。

full_list.title_en: Probing Chern Topology through Hall-Sensitive Photonic Spin Hall Shifts in a d-wave Altermagnet
full_list.title_zh: 通过 d 波交替磁体中的霍尔敏感光子自旋霍尔位移探测陈拓扑
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10706v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we investigate the photonic spin Hall effect in a two-dimensional Rashba-coupled d-wave altermagnetic Chern system subjected to a uniform out-of-plane exchange field. We first analyze the energy-band structure and the Dirac mass distribution at the high-symmetry points, where mΓ=m_M=Δₓ, m_X=Δₓ-4 t_J, and m_Y=Δₓ+4 t_J. Band inversions at high-symmetry points generate both a topologically trivial regime (C=0) and Chern-insulating phases (C= ± 1). Employing the Kubo formalism for the optical conductivity together with the reflection matrix for a substrate-supported conducting sheet, we compute helicity-dependent finite-waist displacements of a reflected Gaussian beam. The resulting optical response exhibits a minimum interband absorption threshold, a Van Hove-type spectral feature, and distinct transitions at the X and Y points arising from the momentum dependence of the exchange field. Under the specified Hall-tensor and polarization sign conventions, the longitudinal helicity half-separation is odd upon reversal of the optical Hall conductivity and correspondingly changes sign between opposite-Chern phases, whereas the transverse half-separation is even in the Hall response. The maximal spin-dependent splitting occur in the vicinity of the pseudo-Brewster reflectance minimum. The longitudinal spin splitting reverses sign between opposite Chern phases, reflecting the exchange-controlled optical Hall response, while its pronounced spectral variations reveal the influence of inequivalent interband transitions induced by the d-wave altermagnetic exchange. These findings establish polarization-resolved photonic beam shifts as a sensitive probe of Hall-active topological phases and their characteristic optical spectra.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了受到均匀面外交换场影响的二维 Rashba 耦合 d 波交磁 Chern 系统中的光子自旋霍尔效应。我们首先分析高对称点处的能带结构和狄拉克质量分布，其中mΓ=m_M=Δₓ，m_X=Δₓ-4 t_J，m_Y=Δₓ+4 t_J。高对称点处的能带反转会产生拓扑平凡状态 (C=0) 和陈绝缘相 (C= ± 1)。采用 Kubo 形式来计算光导率，并结合基底支撑的导电片的反射矩阵，我们计算反射高斯光束的螺旋性相关的有限腰位移。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们研究了受到均匀面外交换场影响的二维 Rashba 耦合 d 波交磁 Chern 系统中的光子自旋霍尔效应。我们首先分析高对称点处的能带结构和狄拉克质量分布，其中mΓ=m_M=Δₓ，m_X=Δₓ-4 t_J，m_Y=Δₓ+4 t_J。高对称点处的能带反转会产生拓扑平凡状态 (C=0) 和陈绝缘相 (C= ± 1)。采用 Kubo 形式来计算光导率，并结合基底支撑的导电片的反射矩阵，我们计算反射高斯光束的螺旋性相关的有限腰位移。由此产生的光学响应表现出最小带间吸收阈值、范霍夫型光谱特征以及由于交换场的动量依赖性而在 X 和 Y 点处产生的明显跃迁。在指定的霍尔张量和偏振符号约定下，纵向螺旋半分离在光学霍尔电导率反转时是奇数，并且相应地在相反的陈相位之间改变符号，而横向半分离在霍尔响应中是偶数。最大的自旋相关分裂发生在伪布儒斯特反射率最小值附近。纵向自旋分裂使相反的陈相之间的符号反转，反映了交换控制的光学霍尔响应，而其明显的光谱变化揭示了由 d 波交磁交换引起的不等价带间跃迁的影响。这些发现将偏振分辨光子束位移确立为霍尔活性拓扑相及其特征光谱的敏感探针。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Embedding from Molecular to Crystalline Environments at the Cost of a Gas-Phase Calculation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantum Embedding from Molecular to Crystalline Environments at the Cost of a Gas-Phase Calculation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12399v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a direct-space formulation and implementation of quantum density functional theory (DFT) embedding for molecular active subsystems embedded in frozen environments (hosts) of arbitrary dimensionality, from finite molecular hosts to extended systems. The host is computed once without the embedded molecule (the guest) and is represented only by its electron density fitted in an atom-centered auxiliary Gaussian basis together with its nuclear charges with the periodic electrostatics separated into an explicit near-field and a continuous fast-multipole far-field operator. The method allows the removal of host atoms from this representation to create vacancies or other voids without requiring a supercell creation. Analytic nuclear gradients are also implemented, enabling structural relaxation of the active subsystem. We demonstrate the versatility of the approach through applications to adsorbates on periodic surfaces and molecules embedded in bulk solvent environments. For CO on MgO(001), we show that DFT-in-DFT converges rapidly and reproduces the periodic interaction energy within 0.44 kJ/mol while reducing the cost by a factor of 27. Real-time time-dependent embedded DFT (RT-TDDFET) of methylenecyclopropene in periodic water is showcased to produce a ~0.6 eV solvatochromic blue shift, while strong-field propagation of CO2 on hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) yields substrate-induced effects at the cost of a gas-phase propagation. Coupling the embedding scheme to excited-state correlated wave function theory methods such as CC2 yields a solvent shift within 0.01 eV of supermolecular CC2 references, while reducing the computational cost by over 500 times.

full_list.title_en: Quartet ferromagnetism in the small-exchange limit
full_list.title_zh: 小交换极限下的四重铁磁性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10512v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth magnets are often regarded as classical owing to their large angular momentum J, but this picture breaks down when exchange is smaller than the crystalline electric-field (CEF) energy scale, allowing the degeneracy of low-lying CEF manifolds to dictate the emergent quantum phases. Here, we uncover such a regime in the RV6Sn6 (R = rare-earth) kagome metals with strong magnetic anisotropy. Thermodynamic and neutron-diffraction measurements reveal successive axial and tilted ferromagnetic (FM) phases in DyV6Sn6, arising from independent ordering of the axial Mz and transverse Mx dipolar components enabled by a rare quasi-quartet ground state. On the other hand, HoV6Sn6 has a similar tilted magnetic anisotropy, but remains axial down to 0.03 K. This discrepancy can be traced back to the non-Kramers nature of Ho3+ where the CEF lifts the quartet degeneracy, leaving a quasi-triplet ground state. Unlike quartets or higher multiplets, we find that the effective spin-1 triplet does not allow independent dipolar ordering without strong quadrupolar (nematic) interactions that act to break rotational symmetry, revealing an essential multipolar prerequisite for tilted magnetic ground states. These results establish a quartet CEF manifold as the minimal degeneracy required for dipolar-driven independent ordering. Mapping the surrounding CEF parameter space further reveals competing magnetic, non-magnetic singlet, and potential quadrupolar phases, driven by multifold ground state degeneracies. These results establish CEF tuning as a versatile route to unconventional quantum phases across the broader RT6X6 (T = transition metal; X = Sn, Ge) family.
full_list.abstract_zh: 稀土磁体由于角动量 J 大，通常被认为是经典磁体，但当交换小于晶体电场 (CEF) 能量尺度时，这种情况就会崩溃，从而允许低位 CEF 流形的简并性决定出现的量子相。在这里，我们在具有强磁各向异性的 RV6Sn6（R = 稀土）kagome 金属中发现了这种状态。热力学和中子衍射测量揭示了 DyV6Sn6 中连续的轴向和倾斜铁磁 (FM) 相，这是由罕见的准四重基态实现的轴向 Mz 和横向 Mx 偶极分量的独立排序引起的。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 稀土磁体由于角动量 J 大，通常被认为是经典磁体，但当交换小于晶体电场 (CEF) 能量尺度时，这种情况就会崩溃，从而允许低位 CEF 流形的简并性决定出现的量子相。在这里，我们在具有强磁各向异性的 RV6Sn6（R = 稀土）kagome 金属中发现了这种状态。热力学和中子衍射测量揭示了 DyV6Sn6 中连续的轴向和倾斜铁磁 (FM) 相，这是由罕见的准四重基态实现的轴向 Mz 和横向 Mx 偶极分量的独立排序引起的。另一方面，HoV6Sn6 具有类似的倾斜磁各向异性，但在低至 0.03 K 时仍保持轴向。这种差异可以追溯到 Ho3+ 的非克莱默性质，其中 CEF 提升了四重态简并性，留下了准三重态基态。与四重态或更高的多重态不同，我们发现有效的自旋1三重态不允许独立的偶极排序，除非强四极（向列）相互作用破坏旋转对称性，揭示了倾斜磁性基态的基本多极先决条件。这些结果建立了四重 CEF 流形作为偶极驱动独立排序所需的最小简并性。映射周围的 CEF 参数空间进一步揭示了由多重基态简并驱动的竞争性磁性、非磁性单线态和潜在的四极相。这些结果确立了 CEF 调谐作为跨更广泛的 RT6X6（T = 过渡金属；X = Sn、Ge）系列的非常规量子相的通用途径。

full_list.title_en: Revealing laser-induced modification of weak ferromagnetism through a spin-reorientation phase transition in iron borate Fe₃BO₆
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Revealing laser-induced modification of weak ferromagnetism through a spin-reorientation phase transition in iron borate Fe₃BO₆
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12460v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the iron oxide Fe₃BO₆ weak ferromagnetism stems from competing contributions from two-site Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions (DMI) and from on-site anisotropies at the two 4c and 8d types of nonequivalent Fe³⁺ sites. As a result, spin reorientation (SR) transition Γ₂ → Γ₄ in Fe₃BO₆ uniquely comprises 90^circ spin switching and a 35% change of weak ferromagnetic moment. We explore ultrafast kinetics of such a transition as a proxy for weak ferromagnetism contributions modified by femtosecond laser pulses. Using magneto-optical pump-probe technique we reveal that the SR transition is triggered by an abrupt decrease of the weak ferromagnetic moment in the Γ₂ phase, and relate it to the laser-induced modification of the DMI and anisotropy contributions to the spin canting. By tuning the pump pulse phonon energy between different optical absorption ranges, we show that laser-driven impact on spin canting possesses a nonthermal character and is achieved through the charge-transfer transitions 2p→3d within Fe³⁺O²⁻₆ octahedra rather than by localized 3d→3d transitions at Fe³⁺. The decreased weak ferromagnetic moment controls the threshold and the latency of the SR transition, as well as a final state. The latter is achieved via the precessional switching to the Γ₄ phase activated by the laser-induced heating. Final state is found to be a coexistence of Γ₄ and Γ₂ phase with modified spin canting persisting even at hundreds of picoseconds.

full_list.title_en: Supercurrent-controlled magnon transport via suppression of the superconducting gap
full_list.title_zh: 通过抑制超导间隙实现超电流控制的磁振子输运
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11781v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding interactions between different low-energy excitations is a central theme in condensed-matter physics. Magnons and superconducting condensates represent two distinct macroscopic quantum states, yet their mutual interaction remains largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate supercurrent-controlled magnon transport in a ferromagnet/superconductor heterostructure. We observe that the magnon transport signal decreases as the supercurrent increases. This suppression originates from a supercurrent-induced reduction of the superconducting gap, which enhances magnon dissipation into the superconductor via Bogoliubov quasiparticles. Our results provide direct experimental evidence of a supercurrent-controlled interaction between magnons and quasiparticles in the superconductor. The approach used in this study relies on supercurrents, enabling magnon modulation without Joule heating. These findings establish a new route to control magnons via superconductivity and pave the way for energy-efficient magnonic devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 理解不同低能激发之间的相互作用是凝聚态物理学的中心主题。磁振子和超导凝聚态代表两种不同的宏观量子态，但它们之间的相互作用在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们展示了铁磁体/超导体异质结构中的超电流控制的磁振子输运。我们观察到磁振子传输信号随着超电流的增加而减少。这种抑制源于超电流引起的超导能隙减小，从而通过博戈留波夫准粒子增强了磁振子耗散到超导体中。我们的结果提供了超导体中磁振子和准粒子之间超电流控制相互作用的直接实验证据。

full_list.title_en: Anatomy of fast current-induced skyrmion motion in synthetic antiferromagnets
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Anatomy of fast current-induced skyrmion motion in synthetic antiferromagnets
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.09948v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The high mobility of current-driven skyrmions in synthetic antiferromagnets (SAFs) is widely explained by the macroscopic suppression of the skyrmion Hall effect through gyrotropic force compensation. This established view, however, overlooks a concurrent and significant reduction in the Gilbert damping parameter α, a key factor in the Thiele equation governing skyrmion velocity. Here, we show that this damping attenuation originates from a reconfigured magnon-electron scattering landscape. Using a microscopic s-d model, we demonstrate that the strong antiferromagnetic interlayer Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) exchange coupling in SAFs increases the magnonic gap of skyrmion collective modes, thereby suppressing the thermal magnon population and, consequently, the magnon-electron scattering rate that dominates damping in metallic ferromagnets. Our work establishes a dual-mechanism framework to fully explain the superior kinetics of SAF skyrmions: the macroscopic topological effect rectifies the motion direction, while the microscopic dissipation mechanism reduces the drag. This synergy enables high-speed and efficient motion, providing a fundamental elucidation of the enhanced mobility reported in recent studies such as the work by Pham et al. [Science 384, 307-312 (2024)].

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Anatomy of fast current-induced skyrmion motion in synthetic antiferromagnets》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Coherent Conversion of an Interacting Dark-State-Polariton Condensate into a Photonic Bose-Einstein Condensate
full_list.title_zh: 相互作用的暗态极化子凝聚态到光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态的相干转换
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An interacting condensate can retain an observable imprint of its preparation after the interactions are switched off. For light, accessing this regime requires separating the formation of a photon condensate from the material medium that redistributes its energy. We investigate a multimode-cavity scheme in which an interacting dark-state-polariton condensate is coherently converted into a confined photonic Bose-Einstein condensate as the atom-cavity coupling is removed. The polariton mass, matter fraction, and particle number control the condensate occupation during preparation. Remarkably, changing the mass also modifies the condensate's response to repulsion through the spatial overlap of its orbitals, even when the entire single-particle spectrum is held fixed. Ideal mode-preserving conversion conserves the full natural-orbital occupation spectrum, while finite-time few-body calculations show that additional occupation changes during transfer are much smaller than those established during interacting preparation. Once decoupled from matter, the photons evolve under the free cavity Hamiltonian while retaining correlations acquired in the interacting gas. Interference between cavity modes produces oscillations in the photon density, while resonant pair correlations persist after interaction removal and distinguish the resulting photon state from a quadratic thermal state with the same one-body density matrix.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在相互作用关闭后，相互作用的冷凝物可以保留其制备过程中可观察到的印记。对于光来说，进入这种状态需要将光子凝聚体的形成与重新分配其能量的材料介质分开。我们研究了一种多模腔方案，其中当原子腔耦合被消除时，相互作用的暗态极化子凝聚态相干地转换为受限光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态。极化激元质量、物质分数和颗粒数控制制备过程中冷凝物的占据。值得注意的是，即使整个单粒子光谱保持固定，改变质量也会通过其轨道的空间重叠来改变凝聚体对排斥的响应。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在相互作用关闭后，相互作用的冷凝物可以保留其制备过程中可观察到的印记。对于光来说，进入这种状态需要将光子凝聚体的形成与重新分配其能量的材料介质分开。我们研究了一种多模腔方案，其中当原子腔耦合被消除时，相互作用的暗态极化子凝聚态相干地转换为受限光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态。极化激元质量、物质分数和颗粒数控制制备过程中冷凝物的占据。值得注意的是，即使整个单粒子光谱保持固定，改变质量也会通过其轨道的空间重叠来改变凝聚体对排斥的响应。理想的保模转换保留了完整的自然轨道占据谱，而有限时间少体计算表明，转移过程中的额外占据变化远小于相互作用准备过程中建立的变化。一旦与物质解耦，光子就会在自由腔哈密顿量下演化，同时保留在相互作用的气体中获得的相关性。腔模式之间的干扰会产生光子密度的振荡，而共振对相关性在相互作用消除后仍然存在，并将所得的光子态与具有相同单体密度矩阵的二次热态区分开来。

full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：声子、有限温度和输运性质、晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Coupled Magnetic and Lattice Excitations in Multiferroic Ba3HoRu2O9: Insights from Neutron Scattering, Raman Spectroscopy, and Machine-Learned Phonon Calculations
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Coupled Magnetic and Lattice Excitations in Multiferroic Ba3HoRu2O9: Insights from Neutron Scattering, Raman Spectroscopy, and Machine-Learned Phonon Calculations
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.23490v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Inelastic neutron scattering (INS) spectra of correlated 4d-4f multiferroic oxides are difficult to interpret because magnetic, crystal-field, and lattice excitations frequently overlap in energy. The hexagonal 6H perovskite Ba3HoRu2O9 provides an ideal platform to investigate this interplay owing to the coexistence of Ru2O9 molecular units and localized Ho3+ moments. To identify the contributions from these different excitations, we combine INS with linear spin-wave calculations, crystal field analysis, Raman spectroscopy, and machine-learned force field (MLFF) phonon calculations. A magnetic excitation below 6.2 meV, observed only in the low-temperature magnetic phase, is reproduced by linear spin-wave theory with intradimer Ru-Ru and Ru-Ho exchange of comparable size and a Ho single-ion anisotropy, and is therefore consistent with a collective spin-wave excitation of the coupled Ru-Ho magnetic network. At higher energies, broad excitations centered near 20, 39, 70, and 90 meV are observed that persist far above the magnetic ordering temperatures. The magnetic part of the 39 meV excitation, isolated by subtracting the Bose-corrected high-temperature data, follows the Ho3+ magnetic form factor. Crystal-field calculations based on the Stevens formalism place a group of strong Ho3+ transitions in this energy range, while Raman spectroscopy and MLFF phonon calculations identify optical phonons with comparable energies. Together, these complementary results show that the broad INS feature near 39 meV arises from overlapping Ho3+ crystal-field excitations and lattice vibrations. These findings establish a microscopic framework for understanding the interplay between spin, crystal-field, and lattice degrees of freedom in this multiferroic 4d-4f compound

full_list.title_en: Localized Excitons and Exciton-Phonon Coupling in Antiferromagnetic AgCrP2S6
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Localized Excitons and Exciton-Phonon Coupling in Antiferromagnetic AgCrP2S6
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.18394v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: AgCrP2S6 combines a low-symmetry thiophosphate framework with an antiferromagnetic Cr sublattice and nonmagnetic Ag sites, where covalency and magnetic localization compete in the low-energy optical response. Using single-crystal x-ray diffraction, Raman spectroscopy, lattice-dynamical calculations, and self-consistent vertex-corrected many-body methods, we determine its structural, electronic, and excitonic properties. The material remains monoclinic from 100 to 300 K, with low-temperature Ag-site disorder, and is dynamically stable. Many-body calculations find a reduced quasiparticle gap relative to Cr trihalides, yet the lowest excitons stay predominantly local: a weakly bright, strongly anisotropic Frenkel exciton near 1.4 eV with dominant onsite d-d character and ligand-assisted d-p admixture. In the C2h setting this state is mainly Bu, with Ag diagonal and Bg bright-dark phonon coupling channels. Stronger p-d hybridization narrows the gap, while antiferromagnetic exchange and Ag dilution suppress intersite coherence. Cation substitution and ligand-ion engineering thus provide a transferable handle for tuning exciton localization in related 2D magnets, with implications for boson coupling and spintronics.

full_list.title_en: Current selects the helicity of a chiral phonon
full_list.title_zh: Current 选择手性声子的螺旋度
full_list.abstract: The emergence of spin-polarized electrons from nonmagnetic chiral molecules and crystals is called Chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS). A chiral phonon of definite wavevector q can strongly enhance it, but near equilibrium the two helicities +q and −q are equally populated: they are time-reversal partners and their contributions cancel. We show that in a biased chiral conductor the current causes the phonon of one helicity to damp less than the other. The damping asymmetry is odd in the current, odd under q → −q, invariant under a mirror that reverses the structural handedness, and equal, mode for mode, to the current-induced nonconservative Berry force on the phonon coordinate. Closing the phonon kinetics with a rate equation turns the asymmetry into a net lattice helicity: at any finite bias one helicity is preferentially populated, with no threshold, growing linearly with the current as V → 0; above a threshold that helicity becomes a self-sustained coherent travelling wave. We demonstrate this effect in elemental tellurium, treated as an open quantum system (electronic Hamiltonian, phonon bath, and electron–phonon coupling) within a quasi-ab initio framework. The electronic Hamiltonian is supplied by a vertex-corrected quasipar-ticle self-consistent GW (QSGˆWQSGˆ QSGˆW) potential with spin–orbit coupling; nuclear displacements are modeled with a machine-learned interatomic potential, which yields chiral phonon modes at finite ±q z on the Γ–A line. The perturbation to the electronic Hamiltonian from a nuclear displacement is approximated by a frozen-phonon deformation potential. In tellurium the damping asymmetry grows linearly with the current, the resulting lattice helicity persists from low temperature to room temperature, and the coherent regime appears below about 20 K at 0.2 V and 40 K at 0.4 V. No optical pump is needed: a bias alone drives the current and selects the phonon helicity; reversing the current reverses the selection.

full_list.abstract_zh_full: 非磁性手性分子和晶体中出现自旋极化电子称为手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）。确定波矢 q 的手性声子可以强烈增强它，但在接近平衡时，两个螺旋 +q 和 -q 的分布是相等的：它们是时间反转伙伴，并且它们的贡献相互抵消。我们证明，在偏置的手性导体中，电流导致一种螺旋性的声子阻尼小于另一种螺旋性的声子。阻尼不对称性在电流中是奇数，在 q → −q 下是奇数，在反转结构旋向性的镜子下不变，并且模式与模式相等，与声子坐标上电流感应的非保守贝里力相同。用速率方程封闭声子动力学将不对称性转化为净晶格螺旋度：在任何有限偏置下，优先填充一个螺旋度，没有阈值，随着 V → 0 随电流线性增长；超过一个阈值，螺旋性就成为自持的相干行波。我们在元素碲中证明了这种效应，将其视为准从头计算框架内的开放量子系统（电子哈密顿量、声子浴和电子声子耦合）。电子哈密顿量由具有自旋轨道耦合的顶点校正准粒子自洽 GW (QSG^WQSG^QSG^W) 势提供；核位移是用机器学习的原子间势来建模的，它在 Γ-A 线上产生有限 ±q z 的手性声子模式。核位移对电子哈密顿量的扰动通过冻结声子变形势来近似。在碲中，阻尼不对称性随电流线性增长，由此产生的晶格螺旋度从低温到室温持续存在，并且相干范围出现在 0.2 V 时约 20 K 和 0.4 V 时约 40 K 以下。不需要光泵：仅靠偏置驱动电流并选择声子螺旋度；反转电流会反转选择。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Current 选择手性声子的螺旋度》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Toward universal excited-state machine-learned potentials: a local excitation Hamiltonian for size consistency and transferability
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Toward universal excited-state machine-learned potentials: a local excitation Hamiltonian for size consistency and transferability
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11019v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Universal machine-learned interatomic potentials could make excited-state simulations across chemical space routine, but excitation energies, unlike ground-state energies, are not sums of atomic contributions. The excited states of noninteracting molecules are the union of their states, which pooled multistate readouts reproduce at best for the lowest state. We introduce LEH-MACE, whose excitation energies are the eigenvalues of a local excitation Hamiltonian assembled from atom-centred blocks, so this union holds exactly. We generated TD-DFT energies and forces for about 300,000 equilibrium, thermal, and excited-state geometries of over 100,000 molecules. LEH-MACE's advantage over direct readouts grew with the distance from the training data and was largest above S₁, with about half their S₂ and S₃ errors for long conjugated oligomers. For molecule pairs, only LEH-MACE kept its single-molecule accuracy, while a softmin readout remained superior for S₁ dynamics of larger chromophores. Exact size consistency is thus one step toward such potentials.

full_list.implication: 对《Toward universal excited-state machine-learned potentials: a local excitation Hamiltonian for size consistency and transferability》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Mechanisms of Zener diode and ohmic contact resulting from a heavily doped p-n junction: A novel explanation in terms of impurity-photovoltaic-effect resulting from infrared self-emission at room-temperature
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Mechanisms of Zener diode and ohmic contact resulting from a heavily doped p-n junction: A novel explanation in terms of impurity-photovoltaic-effect resulting from infrared self-emission at room-temperature
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12431v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In textbooks, a quantum-mechanical tunneling mechanism based on electron-wavefunction is used to explain Zener diode as well as ohmic contact resulting from a heavily doped p-n junction. In this study, an attempt in particle description is made to explain these devices. Any object at room-temperature emits infrared (IR) photons. The process of heavy doping can cause many defects. The self-absorption of the IR emission could be achieved through sub-band-gap excitations due to defects, creating carriers. In a heavily doped p-n junction device, some of the IR-generated carriers diffuse into the junction which has a built-in field. The built-in field sweeps out the carriers, creating IR photocurrent. The reverse leakage current of the p-n junction is regarded as the IR photocurrent according to a precedent where impurity-photovoltaic-effect is used to explain circuit devices (arXiv:2510.18226). Heavy doping results in not only a great many IR-generated carriers but also an avalanche effect at low voltage, producing Zener breakdown. Additionally, the impurity-photovoltaic-effect can make a reasonable contribution to explaining the temperature dependence of Zener breakdown. If the doping is very heavy, the heavily doped p-n junction can be altered to create an ohmic contact, which can also be explained in terms of impurity-photovoltaic-effect. Not only quantum mechanics, but also this photovoltaic mechanism in particle description can explain the above devices. Considering the wave-particle duality, the combination of quantum-mechanical and photovoltaic mechanisms is suggested to explain these devices. Each mechanism plays a big or small role in the explanation.

full_list.title_en: Synthesis of Magnetic Nanocatalyst CaO/CoFe3O4 for Biodiesel Production using Pongamia pinnata oil Seed
full_list.title_zh: 利用水黄皮油籽合成用于生物柴油生产的磁性纳米催化剂 CaO/CoFe3O4
full_list.abstract: Biodiesel has emerged as prominent alternative source for commercial fuels. Pongamia pinnata (P. pinnata) has been recognised as the potential source for biodiesel, prepared from its seeds. The present study is to develop a novel heterogenous magnetic nano catalyst CaO/CoFe3O4 for the preparation of biodiesel from P. pinnata through transesterification reaction and improve the catalyst reusability. Magnetic core Fe3O4 and CoFe3O4 were prepared by co-precipitation method. Crab shell was calcinated at 600°C for 4 h for the preparation of calcium oxide (CaO). CaO/CoFe3O4 was synthesized by doping of CaO and CoFe3O4. Characterization of the synthesised catalyst was done using Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy, Scanning Electron Microscopy, X-ray Diffraction and Particle Size Analyzer to analyses the functional group, morphology, crystalline structure and particle size respectively. The optimized parameter for biodiesel production by transesterification are 12:1 molar ratio of methanol to oil, 2.5wt% catalyst concentration, 120 min reaction time, 65°C reaction temperature and 500 rpm stirring rate to give a maximum of 98.56 wt% yield. The reusability study conferred that the biodiesel yield of above 92 wt% were obtained when regenerating and reusing the catalyst up to six cycles, further the yield drops below 65 wt% at ninth cycle of catalyst reusability. After transesterification, the fuel properties were analyzed using ASTM D6751 standard and it was found within prescribe limit.
full_list.abstract_zh: 生物柴油已成为商业燃料的重要替代来源。水黄皮 (P. pinnata) 已被认为是从其种子中制备生物柴油的潜在来源。本研究旨在开发一种新型多相磁性纳米催化剂CaO/CoFe3O4，用于通过酯交换反应从P. pinnata制备生物柴油，并提高催化剂的重复使用性。采用共沉淀法制备了磁芯Fe3O4和CoFe3O4。将蟹壳在 600°C 下煅烧 4 h，制备氧化钙 (CaO)。通过CaO和CoFe3O4的掺杂合成了CaO/CoFe3O4。

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《利用水黄皮油籽合成用于生物柴油生产的磁性纳米催化剂 CaO/CoFe3O4》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Investigation of Photocatalytic, Piezoelectric and Dielectric Properties of Sol- Gel Synthesized Barium Titanate Nanoparticles Reinforced into PMMA Polymer Matrices Nanocomposites for Multifunctional Applications
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Investigation of Photocatalytic, Piezoelectric and Dielectric Properties of Sol- Gel Synthesized Barium Titanate Nanoparticles Reinforced into PMMA Polymer Matrices Nanocomposites for Multifunctional Applications
full_list.abstract: This research focuses on the synthesis and characterization of nanocomposites consisting of barium titanate (BaTiO₃) nanoparticles reinforced into poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) polymer matrices. The nanocomposites were prepared using a solution-casting technique, while the barium titanate nanoparticles were synthesized via a conventional sol-gel method followed by calcination at 800°C for 1 hour. Structural, morphological, photocatalytic, piezoelectric, and dielectric properties were evaluated using several characterization techniques, including FTIR, XRD, SEM, UV-Vis spectroscopy, a d33 meter, and an LCR analyzer. FTIR analysis identified absorption bands corresponding to Ba-O and Ti-O, as well as organic functional groups associated with the PMMA polymer matrices. XRD analysis confirmed the tetragonal structure of BaTiO₃ nanoparticles with an average crystallite size of 14.49 nm. SEM analysis determined the particle size to be approximately 37 nm. UV-Vis spectroscopy evaluated the nanoparticles band-gap 2.92 eV and assessed photocatalytic activity. Under UV irradiation, both nanocomposites progressively degraded methylene blue (MB), with the 30 wt% BTO/PMMA nanocomposite achieving the highest degradation efficiency of 24.41% after 75 min. The piezoelectric co-efficient was evaluated 35 pC/N and 37 pC/N with d33 meter analysis. The dielectric, impedance and modulus characteristics were observed over the low-high frequency range 40–110 MHz. The dielectric constant was determined 4.35 and 17.11 for 20 and 30 wt% BTO/PMMA nanocomposites, respectively, at low frequency range, which decreased gradually with increasing frequency, following modest dielectric constant 3.36 and 9.98 at high frequency range 1M-110M Hz, along with high ac conductivity 3.5×10− 3 S(:cm⁻¹) and 5.98×10− 3 S(:cm⁻¹). Impedance and electrical-modulus analysis further revealed broad non-Debye relaxation behavior associated with heterogeneous BTO/PMMA interfaces and localized charge-transport processes. The dispersion of Z″ and M″ plots with increasing frequency indicates the occurrence of dielectric relaxation. Overall, these results identified relatively higher BaTiO₃ reinforcement enhanced multifunctional properties which support BTO/PMMA nanocomposite as a promising processable platform for dielectric components and photocatalytic pollutant-remediation applications.

full_list.title_en: 2D coherent spectroscopy of topological insulators
full_list.title_zh: 拓扑绝缘体的二维相干光谱
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10905v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multidimensional coherent spectroscopy probes the response of a system to a sequence of time-separated light pulses, and has attracted significant interest in recent years. In the frequency space, it generates multidimensional spectra, in which information about different degrees of freedom of the system is generically disentangled. In this work, we develop a quantum geometric formulation of multidimensional optical susceptibilities in insulating systems. Focusing on a two-pulse setup and working in the velocity gauge, we derive analytical expressions for second-order and third-order two-dimensional coherent spectra (2DCS). We focus on the third-order ABB response, which remains finite in centrosymmetric systems where the second-order susceptibility vanishes by inversion symmetry. Its paramagnetic contribution supports an echo signal that probes products of four interband Berry-connection matrix elements, which reduce in two-band systems to bilinear combinations of the quantum geometric tensor of the occupied band. Using continuum and square-lattice models of two-dimensional Chern insulators, we show how the echo resolves the momentum-space sign structure of these geometric quantities. For the xxyx response of the models considered, the number of nodes in the echo signal is related to the band topology. Our results extend the quantum-geometric interpretation of multidimensional spectroscopy to higher-order responses, showing that third-order 2DCS provides access to geometric structures beyond those probed at lower orders.
full_list.abstract_zh: 多维相干光谱探测系统对一系列时间分离的光脉冲的响应，近年来引起了人们的极大兴趣。在频率空间中，它生成多维谱，其中系统不同自由度的信息通常被解开。在这项工作中，我们开发了绝缘系统中多维光学磁化率的量子几何公式。着眼于双脉冲设置并在速度计中工作，我们推导了二阶和三阶二维相干谱（2DCS）的解析表达式。我们关注三阶 ABB 响应，该响应在中心对称系统中仍然是有限的，其中二阶磁化率因反演对称性而消失。

full_list.title_en: 2D polaritons for Squeezing and Shrinking Light
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：2D polaritons for Squeezing and Shrinking Light
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.10754v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) materials have emerged as an extraordinary platform for polaritonics, given their remarkable ability to confine light to deep sub-wavelength scales. However, as material thicknesses reach the nanometer limit, macroscopic electrodynamic models become inadequate for the description of light-matter coupling in 2D materials, leaving a significant gap in our understanding of 2D polaritons. In this work, we develop a comprehensive quantum microscopic framework that describes 2D polaritons through a general, scale-less Hamiltonian. Starting from the quantum properties of a polarizable 2D surface, we derive collective excitations and we identify both transverse electric magnetic modes existing outside the light cone. Our results demonstrate that these 2D systems facilitate a powerful synergy between extreme wavelength shrinking and intrinsic quantum squeezing of electric field quadratures. By establishing this theoretical roadmap, our work provides the essential architecture for controlling non-classical states of light at the nanoscale, opening new avenues for high-precision quantum sensing and the development of next-generation optoelectronic devices

full_list.title_en: A Microscopic Model Underpinning Macroscopic QED in Active Media
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Microscopic Model Underpinning Macroscopic QED in Active Media
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.11557v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We establish a microscopic foundation for macroscopic quantum electrodynamics in active media. Starting from a driven three-level system, we derive an effective two-level description with nonequilibrium stationary populations and employ a quantum central limit approach to obtain collective Langevin dynamics. This construction yields the electromagnetic susceptibility and quantum noise-current correlations from the same microscopic stationary state, providing a direct connection to the reservoir operators of conventional macroscopic quantum electrodynamics. We show that the optical response is governed by the population difference, whereas the noise correlations depend separately on the populations of the two levels. Consequently, at optical transparency, the imaginary part of the susceptibility vanishes while quantum fluctuations remain finite. We interpret the resulting noise statistics in terms of an effective reservoir occupation and a purification involving two vacuum modes, and establish a corresponding effective-temperature fluctuation--dissipation relation. Finally, we demonstrate that the residual fluctuations at transparency can induce finite heating of a nearby quantum probe.

full_list.title_en: Ambient-pressure superconductivity in bulk single crystals of La₅Ni₄O₁₀
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Ambient-pressure superconductivity in bulk single crystals of La₅Ni₄O₁₀
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.12788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductivity in the Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates has so far been confined either to multilayer compounds under high pressure or to square-planar infinite-layer-type films stabilized by epitaxial strain. Here we report the high-pressure high-temperature (HPHT) growth of bulk single crystals of the quadruple-layer RP nickelate La₅Ni₄O₁₃ (n=4) and reproduce the quintuple-layer La₆Ni₅O₁₆ (n=5) synthesis, two members of the series that had previously been accessible only as thin films. Topotactic reduction of La₅Ni₄O₁₃ single crystals with CaH₂ yields the square-planar phase La₅Ni₄O₁₀, which we show to be a bulk, ambient-pressure superconductor with T_c^onset approx 18,K, a shielding fraction above 60%, and a specific-heat jump that confirms a bulk pairing transition. All crystals show besides superconductivity a coexistence with a density-wave or metal-insulator transition. The upper critical field shows a small anisotropy, γ approx 2.4, which remains finite as T → T_c, indicating three-dimensional superconductivity with substantial coupling between the four-layer blocks. These results identify the square-planar nickelates Rₙ₊₁NiₙO₂ₙ₊₂ as a bulk platform in which the layer number alone tunes the nickel valence into the superconducting regime, without chemical substitution, pressure, or epitaxial constraint.

core_items.title_en: A data-driven approach for systematic correction of electronic bandgaps
core_items.title_zh: 电子带隙系统校正的数据驱动方法
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.10889v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that a single machine-learning correction, applied to bandgaps from density functional theory calculations with two of the most frequently used energy functionals, results in bandgaps that are close to the experimental values. This solves a classical problem of computationally efficient electronic structure methods, to give reliable bandgaps that can be compared to experiments. The employed approach relies on materials specific feature engineering of machine learning models, and is shown to have close accuracy to that of much more expensive calculations based on the GW-approximation or hybrid functionals. The findings reported here open the possibility to use efficient calculations in materials design workflows that need reliable bandgaps, with implications for investigations targeting large computational databases or for investigations that are entirely predictive in nature.
core_items.abstract_zh: 我们证明，将单个机器学习校正应用于使用两种最常用的能量泛函的密度泛函理论计算的带隙，会产生接近实验值的带隙。这解决了计算高效的电子结构方法的经典问题，给出了可以与实验进行比较的可靠带隙。所采用的方法依赖于机器学习模型的材料特定特征工程，并且被证明与基于 GW 近似或混合泛函的更昂贵的计算具有接近的准确性。这里报告的研究结果开启了在需要可靠带隙的材料设计工作流程中使用高效计算的可能性，这对针对大型计算数据库的研究或本质上完全预测的研究具有影响。

core_items.title_en: MCSA: Multi-Cutoff Spectral Aggregation in SO(3) Equivariant GNNs for Interatomic Potentials
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：MCSA: Multi-Cutoff Spectral Aggregation in SO(3) Equivariant GNNs for Interatomic Potentials
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.11226v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials (MLIPs) based on Equivariant Graph Neural Networks (EGNNs) have achieved remarkable progress in atomistic modeling. However, accurately representing atomic interactions across different spatial scales remains challenging. In this work, we investigate the radial spectral properties of SO(3)-equivariant message passing and establish that the cutoff radius controls the characteristic spatial-frequency scale of radial interactions. Based on this analysis, we propose Multi-Cutoff Spectral Aggregation (MCSA), a plug-and-play module that aggregates radial kernels with different cutoff radii to enrich multi-scale geometric representations. To achieve efficient implementation, we exploit the compact support of radial kernels to fuse cutoff-dependent radial weights before angular tensor-product operations, avoiding redundant angular computations while preserving rotational equivariance. Extensive experiments across representative EGNN backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in energy, force, and stress prediction, as well as enhanced accuracy in higher-order properties, including phonon dispersion and lattice thermal conductivity. Further evaluations on layered materials with distinct interaction scales demonstrate the effectiveness of physically motivated cutoff selection. Code is available at: https://github.com/JF-Tan/MCSA.

core_items.title_en: Engineering ferroelectric nanocapacitors through interfacial phonon bias
core_items.title_zh: 通过界面声子偏置设计铁电纳米电容器
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.11256v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As ferroelectric devices approach the nanometer scale, their behavior becomes increasingly sensitive to boundary conditions. In perovskite oxide nanocapacitors, epitaxial strain and electrostatic screening are well-established control parameters. Then, while expected to contribute to the epitaxial stabilization of ferroelectric ultrathin films, the lattice-dynamical state of the electrodes has not been isolated as an independent tuning knob. Here we call this poorly explored coupling interfacial phonon bias, whereby the electrodes' phonon energy landscape reshapes that of the adjacent ferroelectric across their shared interface. Using first-principles-accurate machine-learned interatomic potentials and molecular-dynamics simulations, we examine this mechanism in symmetric BiFeO{}₃ nanocapacitors in contact with a metallic perovskite oxide. By independently controlling the orientatio and amplitude of the electrodes' octahedral-tilt landscape, while keeping conventional elastic and electric boundary conditions fixed, we show that the electrodes' phonon energy landscape can modify the stability of competing BiFeO{}₃ phases. In particular, this allows us to shift the ferroelectric transition temperature and even induce antiferroelectric-like switching at ambient conditions. We thus showcase interfacial phonon bias as a complementary and powerful strategy to modify and optimize the properties of ultrathin epitaxial films.
core_items.abstract_zh: 随着铁电器件接近纳米尺度，它们的行为对边界条件变得越来越敏感。在钙钛矿氧化物纳米电容器中，外延应变和静电屏蔽是公认的控制参数。然后，虽然预计有助于铁电超薄膜的外延稳定，但电极的晶格动力学状态尚未被隔离为独立的调谐旋钮。在这里，我们将这种探索不足的耦合界面声子偏置称为耦合界面声子偏置，电极的声子能量景观通过其共享界面重塑相邻铁电体的声子能量景观。利用第一原理精确的机器学习原子间势和分子动力学模拟，我们研究了与金属钙钛矿氧化物接触的对称 BiFeO{}₃ 纳米电容器中的这种机制。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 随着铁电器件接近纳米尺度，它们的行为对边界条件变得越来越敏感。在钙钛矿氧化物纳米电容器中，外延应变和静电屏蔽是公认的控制参数。然后，虽然预计有助于铁电超薄膜的外延稳定，但电极的晶格动力学状态尚未被隔离为独立的调谐旋钮。在这里，我们将这种探索不足的耦合界面声子偏置称为耦合界面声子偏置，电极的声子能量景观通过其共享界面重塑相邻铁电体的声子能量景观。利用第一原理精确的机器学习原子间势和分子动力学模拟，我们研究了与金属钙钛矿氧化物接触的对称 BiFeO{}₃ 纳米电容器中的这种机制。通过独立控制电极八面体倾斜景观的方向和振幅，同时保持传统的弹性和电边界条件固定，我们表明电极的声子能量景观可以改变竞争的 BiFeO{}₃ 相的稳定性。特别是，这使我们能够改变铁电转变温度，甚至在环境条件下诱导类似反铁电的切换。因此，我们展示了界面声子偏置作为一种补充且强大的策略来修改和优化超薄外延膜的性能。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《通过界面声子偏置设计铁电纳米电容器》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Orbital texture of valence band and interband transitions of the type-II multiferroic van der Waals NiI₂
core_items.title_zh: II 型多铁范德华 NiI2 的价带和带间跃迁的轨道结构
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.11425v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: NiI₂ is a van der Waals semiconductor characterized by complex electronic and magnetic phases, holding promise towards functional applications. For this purpose, a detailed understanding of its band structure and its excitations is essential to elucidate the electronic and transport properties. We present a comprehensive description of the band structure and of the lowest valence-to-conduction band transition in bulk NiI₂, by means of time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy supported by first-principles calculations. We describe the orbital character of Ni and I manifolds, and identify the main momentum-resolved features of the valence band and the shallow minima of the conduction band. With this study, we provide a foundational understanding of the electronic structure of NiI₂ and its single-particle interband electronic excitation, a benchmark for theoretical models, and a framework for future investigations on this material.
core_items.abstract_zh: NiI2 是一种范德华半导体，具有复杂的电子相和磁相，有望实现功能应用。为此，详细了解其能带结构及其激发对于阐明电子和传输特性至关重要。我们通过第一性原理计算支持的时间和角度分辨光电子能谱，对块状 NiI2 中的能带结构和最低价态到导带的跃迁进行了全面的描述。我们描述了 Ni 和 I 流形的轨道特征，并确定了价带和导带浅极小值的主要动量分辨特征。

core_items.title_en: Defects and Structural Evolution in CrSBr: Machine-Learning Potentials for Atomistic Simulations
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Defects and Structural Evolution in CrSBr: Machine-Learning Potentials for Atomistic Simulations
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.12267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The layered van der Waals semiconductor CrSBr combines intrinsic magnetic order with semiconducting and optical properties, making it a promising material for multifunctional electronic and photonic applications. Understanding how defects and structural transformations affect its properties under experimentally relevant conditions, however, remains challenging for first-principles simulations due to the relevant length and time scales. Here, we develop and benchmark machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for the Cr-S-Br system, enabling large-scale atomistic simulations of CrSBr with accuracy approaching that of density functional theory (DFT). The charge-aware variant qNEP achieves near-DFT accuracy in predicting lattice constants, formation enthalpies, vacancy energetics, and the anisotropic pressure response of o-CrSBr. Nudged elastic band calculations reveal that pre-existing S vacancies lower the Cr Frenkel-pair migration barrier by up to 1.1 eV, providing an atomistic mechanism for beam-induced Cr redistribution and structural transformations. Displacement threshold calculations further show that Br is the most susceptible species to electron-beam-induced displacement, identifying the relative ease of removing different atomic species. Together, these results establish a validated computational framework for investigating atomic-scale disorder and structural transformations in CrSBr, providing a basis for defect engineering in materials for future magneto-optoelectronic applications.

core_items.title_en: Overcoming speed-accuracy trade-offs with medium-sized interatomic potentials
core_items.title_zh: 克服中等原子间势的速度与精度的权衡
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.11544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current machine-learned interatomic potentials offer a choice between small, fast models and large, expressive networks. This study demonstrates how an intermediate potential can approach the limit of transferable accuracy at the cost of the cheapest existing formalisms. Specifically, we model He-bearing W-Ta-Hf-Cr-V-Ti alloys with an atomic cluster expansion that learns the radial components of each polynomial as independent linear transforms and embeds numerous densities with learned exponents. While (near-)training loss appears largely a function of model size, the error on a distinct validation set is close to that of leading potentials with ten times more parameters. Taking advantage of the new structure, we develop optimized implementations that run more than an order of magnitude faster than the larger models and many times faster than smaller models with equivalent polynomials. The potential is trained on systematically enumerated small structures but generalizes to point and planar defects and can be extended to even more complex chemistries. As a demonstration, we simulate radiation-damage cascades in billion-atom systems for hundreds of thousands of timesteps.
core_items.abstract_zh: 当前的机器学习原子间势提供了小型、快速模型和大型、富有表现力的网络之间的选择。这项研究展示了中间势如何以最便宜的现有形式主义为代价接近可转移精度的极限。具体来说，我们使用原子团簇展开对含氦 W-Ta-Hf-Cr-V-Ti 合金进行建模，该原子团簇展开将每个多项式的径向分量学习为独立的线性变换，并使用学习的指数嵌入大量密度。虽然（接近）训练损失很大程度上取决于模型大小，但不同验证集上的误差接近于参数多十倍的领先潜力的误差。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 当前的机器学习原子间势提供了小型、快速模型和大型、富有表现力的网络之间的选择。这项研究展示了中间势如何以最便宜的现有形式主义为代价接近可转移精度的极限。具体来说，我们使用原子团簇展开对含氦 W-Ta-Hf-Cr-V-Ti 合金进行建模，该原子团簇展开将每个多项式的径向分量学习为独立的线性变换，并使用学习的指数嵌入大量密度。虽然（接近）训练损失很大程度上取决于模型大小，但不同验证集上的误差接近于参数多十倍的领先潜力的误差。利用新结构，我们开发了优化的实现，其运行速度比较大模型快一个数量级以上，比具有等效多项式的较小模型快许多倍。这种潜力是针对系统枚举的小型结构进行训练的，但可以推广到点和平面缺陷，并且可以扩展到更复杂的化学物质。作为演示，我们模拟了十亿个原子系统中数十万个时间步长的辐射损伤级联。

core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《克服中等原子间势的速度与精度的权衡》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Learning Electronic Band Structures Across the s, p, d Blocks with an Empirical Pseudopotential Network
core_items.title_zh: 使用经验赝势网络学习跨 s、p、d 块的电子能带结构
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.11070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic band structures govern how crystals conduct electrons and absorb light. Density-functional theory (DFT) computes them through costly self-consistent iterations, while existing machine-learning models either predict isolated scalar properties or output Hamiltonians that still require DFT solvers. Here we present EpNet, a learned empirical pseudopotential for crystals spanning 63 elements across the s, p and d blocks. An equivariant neural network builds its Hamiltonian from physics-motivated local potentials and nonlocal projectors. Trained solely on band energies, EpNet predicts complete band structures directly from atomic coordinates. On unseen chemical systems, its median errors are winAll eV for band energies and gapAll eV for band gaps. On 600,000 structures from an independent database, its band-gap errors are overall less than half those of existing models, at about 1% of DFT cost. EpNet thus enables fast screening of electronic properties for materials discovery and electronic-structure simulations of large systems.
core_items.abstract_zh: 电子能带结构控制晶体传导电子和吸收光的方式。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 通过成本高昂的自洽迭代来计算它们，而现有的机器学习模型要么预测孤立的标量属性，要么输出仍需要 DFT 求解器的哈密顿量。在这里，我们提出了 EpNet，这是一种学习的晶体经验赝势，跨越 s、p 和 d 块的 63 个元素。等变神经网络根据物理驱动的局部势和非局部投影构建其哈密顿量。 EpNet 仅根据能带能量进行训练，直接从原子坐标预测完整的能带结构。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 电子能带结构控制晶体传导电子和吸收光的方式。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 通过成本高昂的自洽迭代来计算它们，而现有的机器学习模型要么预测孤立的标量属性，要么输出仍需要 DFT 求解器的哈密顿量。在这里，我们提出了 EpNet，这是一种学习的晶体经验赝势，跨越 s、p 和 d 块的 63 个元素。等变神经网络根据物理驱动的局部势和非局部投影构建其哈密顿量。 EpNet 仅根据能带能量进行训练，直接从原子坐标预测完整的能带结构。在不可见的化学系统中，其中值误差对于带能来说是 winAll eV ，对于带隙来说是gapAll eV 。在来自独立数据库的 600,000 个结构上，其带隙误差总体上不到现有模型的一半，约为 DFT 成本的 1%。因此，EpNet 能够快速筛选电子特性，用于材料发现和大型系统的电子结构模拟。

core_items.title_en: An Extensible Agentic Framework for Expert-Level Automation of Atomistic Simulations
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：An Extensible Agentic Framework for Expert-Level Automation of Atomistic Simulations
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2606.09422v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Traditionally, atomistic simulation has been constrained by the computational scaling limits of ab initio methods and the parameterization overhead of empirical force fields. The recent emergence of universal machine learning interatomic potentials has significantly mitigated these bottlenecks, offering near-quantum accuracy and generalizability across diverse chemical spaces at a fraction of the computational cost. However, this shift has relocated the bottleneck to the human dimension: time-consuming mechanical processes, such as input preparation and data analysis, now dominate the research lifecycle. We introduce Paimon, a Platform for Agentic Integration in Materials Optimization and Nanoscale-simulations. Through hundreds of trials on an expert-level liquid electrolyte simulation, we show that Paimon substantially improves the reliability of agentic workflows by suppressing silent errors: plausible yet physically incorrect results. Paimon accommodates a new capability without modifying the agents already present, which we demonstrate by integrating an externally developed scientific agent. As an agent harness for atomistic simulations, Paimon affords researchers a continuous, science-centric workflow throughout the entire simulation lifecycle.

core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《An Extensible Agentic Framework for Expert-Level Automation of Atomistic Simulations》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。
